根据 9 个主会话（约 3000+ 轮对话）整理如下**防误改指南**，按「已定决策 / 勿动区域 / 半成品 / 常见踩坑」分类。

---

## 一、项目定位（先理解再改）

这是一个 **论文润色 + 降 AIGC** 的 Web 产品，参考 [BypassAIGC](https://github.com/chi111i/BypassAIGC) 结构，技术栈为：

- 前端：`React + Vite + Ant Design`（**不是** Tailwind/daisyUI）
- 后端：`FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Alembic`
- 模型：云 GPU 上的 vLLM（OpenAI 兼容接口），**不是 Ollama**

Git 仓库：`https://github.com/k856487/Downaigc.git`

---

## 二、已明确删除 —— 不要再加回来

| 已删内容 | 原因 | 误改后果 |
|---------|------|---------|
| `training/` 整个目录 | 失败半成品 + 体积膨胀 | 重新引入几 GB 垃圾 |
| `paper-humanizer-zh/` | 不在运行必需范围 | 打包变大 |
| Ollama 全链路（`OLLAMA_*`、11434 调用） | 已切云 GPU / 本地 transformers | 推理链路冲突 |
| `backend/.env.gray.sample`、`switch-gray.ps1`、`GRAY_ROLLOUT_PLAN.md` | 灰度/A/B 已废弃 | 配置混乱 |
| `docs/LOCAL_MERGED_MODEL_SERVE.md` | 已改为 AutoDL/vLLM 模式 | 文档与代码不一致 |
| Tailwind + daisyUI 方案 | 与现有 AntD 主题体系冲突 | 双套样式体系 |

**轻量化原则**：上线只保留 `frontend` + `backend` +（可选）`kiterforth` 权重目录。`kiterforth` 本体约 6GB，不是代码问题。

---

## 三、模型推理 —— 核心架构，慎改

### 当前模式（2026-05 后）

```
配置了 REMOTE_INFERENCE_URL → 只 HTTP 调云 vLLM
未配置 → 本机 transformers 加载 kiterforth（需 requirements-local-llm.txt）
```

### 关键约定（用户明确要求）

1. **远程推理时不发 system prompt**，只发段落正文（`user` 单条消息）
2. URL 可只填映射根（如 `https://xxx:8443`），会自动补 `/v1/chat/completions`
3. 降 AIGC / 润色：**逐段调用**，段内再按逗号/句号切成 ≤70 字短句依次请求后拼接
4. 有后处理：`finalize_reduce_text`、摘要/关键词/参考文献识别、字数差 >30 重试、文献序号上传时过滤等

### 勿随意恢复

- 复杂的 `build_reduce_system_and_user` 长提示词链（远程模式下已 bypass）
- `SIMPLE_PARAGRAPH_REWRITE` 开关（已移除，逻辑并入 `_use_remote_inference()`）
- Ollama 模型名如 `huggingface.co/k86574/kiterforth`

### 相关文件

- `backend/main.py` — 推理主逻辑（改动影响最大）
- `backend/.env.example` — `REMOTE_INFERENCE_*` / `LOCAL_*`
- `backend/requirements.txt` vs `requirements-local-llm.txt`

---

## 四、UI/UX —— 反复打磨，别「顺手重构」

### 视觉体系（苹果风 + 渐变背景）

| 决策 | 涉及文件 | 注意 |
|-----|---------|------|
| 白主题：两色对角渐变背景（紫+蓝） | `styles.css` 的 `--bg-page` / `--bg-auth-page` | 暗色主题用独立变量，勿污染 |
| 登录页单独背景 | `AuthLayout.tsx` | 用 `--bg-auth-page`，不影响其他页 |
| 控制台**无顶栏**，仅右上悬浮图标 | `AppHeader.tsx`、`ConsoleLayout.tsx` | 用户明确去掉 header 条 |
| 主内容区**不是** `ant-layout` 壳 | `ConsoleLayout.tsx` | 曾挡背景，已改成 `div` 容器 |
| 侧栏悬浮卡片、圆角、204px 宽 | `console-main-sider` 系列 CSS | 收起动画调了很多轮 |
| 按钮两档：磨砂黑主按钮 + 半透明白次按钮 | `styles.css` | 用户要求去掉光圈/发光 |
| 广告轮播圆角 + slick-dots 样式 | `AdCarousel.tsx`、`styles.css` | 切换时直角闪烁已修 |

### 侧栏收起动画（高风险区）

- 最终形态：收起后约 **54×54 圆角方块**，仅保留折叠图标
- 用 `compactCollapsed` + CSS 过渡，**不要在 Sider 上写内联 `transition`**（会覆盖 CSS 动画）
- 改这里极易回到「第二段瞬间收起 / 图标跳位 / 闪直角」等老问题

### 登录页（LoginPage）

- 文案：`提笔行文思漫漫，润稿提质解君难`
- 问候：`{昵称}，你好呀 (｡･ω･｡)ﾉ♡ 嗨~`（`white-space: nowrap` 防拆行）
- 头像字母有**基线校正**微调表 —— 用户试过很多轮，别改回打字机动画
- 第三方登录（微信/QQ/Google 等）多为 **UI 占位**，未接真实 OAuth

### 顶部钱包/积分条

- 右上角：`余额 ¥` + 充值 `+`、积分 + 增加积分 `+`
- 类名：`app-top-right-cluster`、`app-top-wallet-inline`
- 用户要求**去掉灰色面板**，不要重叠其他 UI

---

## 五、功能模块 —— 已实现 vs 占位

### 已落地（可依赖）

| 模块 | 说明 |
|-----|------|
| 邮箱注册/登录 | 已存在则更新密码并登录 |
| 扫码登录 | `/api/auth/qr-login/*` + `/scan-login` 确认页 |
| 积分 + 看广告 | `RewardContext`、`AdCarousel`、`AdPlayerModal` |
| 签到领积分 | 连续签到递增 |
| 段落工作台 | 左侧段落列表 + 右侧改前/改后对比 |
| 上传/粘贴/目录提取 | `UploadCard`、层级目录、文献摘要 |
| 管理员后台 | `/admin/*`，与用户端同仓库、可拆分 |
| 用户反馈 | 用户端「体验反馈」+ 管理端「用户反馈」+ 待处理角标 |
| 封号/删号 | 管理员操作 + 用户端弹窗 |
| 钱包/充值页 | `WalletPointsPage`、`WalletRechargePage`（git 中有新改动） |
| 兑换码/余额 | 迁移 `20260508_01_redeem_codes_and_balance.py` 等 |

### 占位 / 半成品（别当已完成）

| 模块 | 状态 |
|-----|------|
| 微信/QQ/Google/手机号 OAuth | UI 有，真实鉴权未接 |
| `AuthMethodModal` 里部分 tab | 静态占位 |
| 论文润色页「开始润色」早期计划 | 部分按钮/UI 反复改，以当前代码为准 |
| `论文润色/` uni-app 小程序目录 | 独立子项目，与主站未完全打通 |
| Pencil 设计稿（`.pen`） | 早期原型，实际 UI 已在 React 中重写 |

---

## 六、管理员与账号 —— 敏感信息

聊天记录里出现过：

- 管理员：`kiter` / `poki123`（应在 `.env` 或 seed，**不要写进代码仓库**）
- 测试用户：对话中查过，以数据库为准
- 数据库：`postgresql+psycopg://postgres:123456@127.0.0.1:5432/paper_polish`

**勿提交**：`backend/.env`、模型权重、`node_modules`、`.venv`

---

## 七、部署相关

- 云服务器路径：`C:\apps\Downaigc\`（仅 C 盘）
- 后端：`uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`
- 前端：`npm run dev`（5173），Vite 代理到后端
- 必须先：`alembic upgrade head` + PostgreSQL 可连
- 模型在 AutoDL 等云 GPU，Web 节点只配 `REMOTE_INFERENCE_URL`

---

## 八、改代码前的检查清单

```
□ 是否在恢复已删的 training/Ollama/Tailwind？
□ 是否动到 ConsoleLayout 背景透明/侧栏动画/AppHeader 悬浮结构？
□ 是否给远程模型又加 system prompt（用户明确不要）？
□ 是否改段落切分/后处理/参考文献逻辑（降 AIGC 质量相关）？
□ 是否引入 daisyUI 或换主题体系？
□ 是否误删 slick-dots / ad-carousel-shell 等已修样式？
□ 管理员/用户反馈角标逻辑是否两边都要更新？
```

---

## 九、按文件的风险等级

| 风险 | 文件/目录 |
|-----|----------|
| 🔴 极高 | `backend/main.py`、`frontend/src/layouts/ConsoleLayout.tsx`、`frontend/src/styles.css` |
| 🟠 高 | `AppHeader.tsx`、`LoginPage.tsx`、`SideNav.tsx`、`UploadCard.tsx`、`RewardContext.tsx` |
| 🟡 中 | `AuthMethodModal.tsx`、`AdCarousel.tsx`、各 admin 页面、alembic 迁移 |
| 🟢 低 | 启动脚本、`.env.example` 注释、文档 |

---

## 十、会话时间线（便于查原文）

| 时期 | 会话 | 主要内容 |
|-----|------|---------|
| 3 月 | `7075032d` | Pencil 设计、BypassAIGC 前端骨架、广告轮播 |
| 3–4 月 | `37ae66d9` | 登录页、主题切换、AuthMethodModal、slick-dots |
| 4 月 | `79b20af5` | 移除 Ollama、瘦身、远程推理 |
| 4–5 月 | `83b15fbc` | **最大会话**：UI 苹果风、管理员、反馈、钱包、降 AIGC 调优、部署 |

---

原因已经定位并修好了。

**原因：** 极光 shader 里用了 `length(max(v, vec2(v.x * f * 0.015, v.y * 1.5)))` 做流星拖尾。这个写法对 **负 x（屏幕左侧）** 衰减更慢、更亮，对 **正 x（右侧）** 衰减很快，所以流星几乎都挤在左边，右边基本是纯黑。

**修改：**
1. 新增对称衰减函数 `streakFalloff`，对左右两侧 x 取 `min`，让流星铺满全屏宽度
2. 背景层通过 `createPortal` 挂到 `document.body`，避免被 `#root` 层叠影响
3. 修正 canvas 尺寸同步，保证铺满 `100vw × 100vh`

已按你的要求处理完毕。

## 根本原因（不是 canvas 没铺满）

原版 shader 里有这一行：

```glsl
length(max(v, vec2(v.x * f * 0.015, v.y * 1.5)))
```

`v.x > 0` 时衰减很快，亮带只出现在 **shader 坐标负 x 一侧**，所以宽屏上永远像「只有左半边有流星」。之前用遮罩、`p -= offset`、多层相加去补，都是在打补丁，还会溢色或留黑边。

Canvas 本身是全屏的（`fixed + 100vw/100vh`），问题在 **采样公式**，不在 DOM 尺寸。

## 修复方案

1. **去掉** 所有遮罩、`p` 偏移、右扩 A/B 等补丁  
2. **`auroraFullScreen`**：按屏宽算 `period`，横向平铺 6 次 `auroraPass`，用 **`max` 合成**（填满又不叠爆颜色）  
3. **再加一层** 略偏上的采样，补右上区域  
4. **`ResizeObserver`** + `setSize(w,h,false)` + CSS `100%`，保证分辨率与显示一致  

## 流星层（重新导入）

独立 **`meteorField`**：
- 56 条、8 泳道、全宽 spawn  
- 与极光分开合成，强度 `× 0.52`，避免再次溢色  

请 **Ctrl+Shift+R** 硬刷新。左右应都有极光拖尾，右侧不应再有一条黑边；流星在极光之上单独叠加。

[REDACTED]

这是典型的「**双开浏览器 = 客户端负载翻倍**」，和你们现在的页面实现强相关，一般不是 Edge 本身有问题。

## 主要原因

### 1. 全屏 WebGL 极光背景（最大头）

暗色主题下 `AnimatedShaderBackground` 会 **每帧** 用 Three.js 跑全屏 fragment shader：

```198:203:frontend/src/components/ui/animated-shader-background.tsx
    const animate = () => {
      frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      if (!visible) return;
      material.uniforms.iTime.value += 0.016;
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };
```

这个 shader 很重：每个像素大约要跑 **5 次 `auroraPass`**，每次里面 **35 次循环 + fbm 噪声**。  
1920×1080、DPR=2 时，相当于每秒对数百万像素做大量数学运算。

- **内置浏览器开一页** → 1 套 WebGL 全速跑  
- **再开 Edge 访问同一页** → 第 2 套 WebGL 全速跑  
→ GPU/CPU 负载接近 **×2**

### 2. 两个窗口都「可见」时不会停

只有当前标签 `document.hidden` 时才会跳过渲染：

```191:200:frontend/src/components/ui/animated-shader-background.tsx
    let visible = document.visibilityState === "visible";
    ...
      if (!visible) return;
```

两个窗口并排、两个标签都可见时，**两个实例都会 60fps 跑 shader**，不会互相让路。

### 3. 全站 `backdrop-filter` 玻璃 UI

暗色主题大量卡片、侧栏、输入框用了 `backdrop-filter: blur(10px)`。  
浏览器要在 WebGL 画布之上再做多层实时模糊合成；**两个浏览器各做一遍**，合成成本也翻倍。

### 4. 开发模式（若 Edge 也连 `localhost:5173`）

Vite dev + React StrictMode 会比生产包更重一些，但通常不如 WebGL 明显。  
双开卡顿时，**首要仍是两个全屏 shader + 多层 blur**。

### 5. 为什么「只开内置浏览器」感觉流畅？

常见原因：

| 因素 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 只有 1 个 WebGL 实例 | 负载减半 |
| 内置预览窗口可能更小 | 像素少，shader 算得少 |
| Edge 可能有扩展/同步/硬件加速策略不同 | 额外占 GPU |
| 核显笔记本 | 两个 3D 上下文很容易顶满 |

---

## 和前后端的关系

登录/概览页卡顿 **主要是前端 GPU**，不是 uvicorn。  
除非 Edge 还开着会轮询的页面（反馈未读数 60s 一次等），那部分影响很小，远小于 shader。

---

## 以后若要优化（你现在不用改）

1. **第二个标签不可见时降帧**（如 30fps）或 **Page Visibility 时完全停 rAF**（已有，但要两个都 hidden 才省一半）  
2. **合并 auroraPass 次数** 或降低循环 35→20  
3. **DPR 上限从 2 降到 1.5 或 1**  
4. **关 `antialias: true`**  
5. 玻璃 UI 减少 `backdrop-filter` 层数，或暗色下改用静态半透明  
6. 生产构建（`npm run build`）比 dev 略轻  

---

**结论**：同时用内置浏览器 + Edge 打开同一暗色页面，等于 **跑两套全屏重 shader + 两套 UI 模糊**，在核显或中端 GPU 上很容易卡。关掉 Edge 里那个标签，或切到别的标签让其中一个 `hidden`，一般会立刻好不少。

TargetCursor 已集成完成，未 hover 时的旋转光标比源码略小。

### 已完成

1. **`TargetCursor.tsx`** — TypeScript 版组件，通过 `createPortal` 挂到 `document.body`
2. **`TargetCursor.css`** — 尺寸略小：圆点 3px、角标 10px、边框 2px
3. **`main.tsx`** — 全局启用，并导出 `TARGET_CURSOR_SELECTOR` 匹配常见可点击元素

### 未 hover 时更小的实现

- **CSS**：角标和圆点比源码（12px / 4px / 3px 边框）略小
- **`idleSpreadScale={0.72}`**：空闲时四角展开半径约为源码的 72%（源码约 `cornerSize * 1.5`，现为 `cornerSize * 1.5 * 0.72`）
- hover 目标时仍按元素边界正常框选，不受影响

### 匹配的可交互元素

按钮、链接、`.ant-btn`、`.galaxy-btn`、菜单项、侧栏切换、登录输入框等；需要额外元素时加 `cursor-target` class，或在 `TARGET_CURSOR_SELECTOR` 里追加选择器。

刷新页面后，桌面端应能看到较小的旋转光标；hover 按钮/链接时会框选目标。若还想再小一点，把 `idleSpreadScale` 调到 `0.6` 左右即可。

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
import secrets
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from models.adhub_entities import (
    AdHubAccount,
    AdHubAdvertiserProfile,
    AdHubChatMessage,
    AdHubChatThread,
    AdHubCooperationIntent,
    AdHubPublisherProfile,
    AdHubQrSlot,
    AdHubReputationLog,
    AdHubWatchEvent,
)


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def get_account(db: Session, account_id: str) -> AdHubAccount | None:
    return db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id)


def get_account_by_openid(db: Session, openid: str) -> AdHubAccount | None:
    return db.scalar(select(AdHubAccount).where(AdHubAccount.openid == openid))


def ensure_publisher_profile(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> AdHubPublisherProfile:
    if account.publisher:
        return account.publisher
    row = AdHubPublisherProfile(account_id=account.id)
    db.add(row)
    db.flush()
    return row


def upsert_weixin_account(
    db: Session, *, openid: str, unionid: str | None, nickname: str, avatar_url: str
) -> AdHubAccount:
    row = get_account_by_openid(db, openid)
    if row:
        if nickname:
            row.nickname = nickname
        if avatar_url:
            row.avatar_url = avatar_url
        if unionid:
            row.unionid = unionid
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(row)
        ensure_publisher_profile(db, row)
        return row
    row = AdHubAccount(
        openid=openid,
        unionid=unionid,
        nickname=nickname or "微信用户",
        avatar_url=avatar_url or "",
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.flush()
    db.add(AdHubPublisherProfile(account_id=row.id))
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _normalize_id_tail(id_number: str) -> str:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", id_number)
    return digits[-4:] if len(digits) >= 4 else digits


def submit_realname(
    db: Session, account: AdHubAccount, *, real_name: str, id_number: str
) -> AdHubPublisherProfile:
    prof = ensure_publisher_profile(db, account)
    name = real_name.strip()
    if len(name) < 2:
        raise ValueError("invalid_name")
    tail = _normalize_id_tail(id_number)
    if len(tail) < 4:
        raise ValueError("invalid_id_number")
    prof.real_name = name
    prof.id_number_tail = tail
    prof.verify_status = "verified"
    prof.verified_at = _now()
    _ensure_qr_slot(db, account)
    _adjust_reputation(db, account.id, +2, "实名认证通过")
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(prof)
    return prof


def _ensure_qr_slot(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> AdHubQrSlot:
    if account.qr_slot:
        return account.qr_slot
    code = secrets.token_urlsafe(9).replace("-", "").replace("_", "")[:12].lower()
    row = AdHubQrSlot(account_id=account.id, code=code)
    db.add(row)
    db.flush()
    return row


def get_qr_by_account(db: Session, account_id: str) -> AdHubQrSlot | None:
    return db.scalar(select(AdHubQrSlot).where(AdHubQrSlot.account_id == account_id))


def get_qr_by_code(db: Session, code: str) -> AdHubQrSlot | None:
    return db.scalar(select(AdHubQrSlot).where(AdHubQrSlot.code == code))


def update_publisher_contact(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    contact_phone: str = "",
    contact_email: str = "",
    website_url: str = "",
    bio: str = "",
) -> AdHubPublisherProfile:
    prof = ensure_publisher_profile(db, account)
    prof.contact_phone = contact_phone.strip()
    prof.contact_email = contact_email.strip()
    prof.website_url = website_url.strip()
    prof.bio = bio.strip()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(prof)
    return prof


def register_advertiser(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    company_name: str,
    contact_name: str,
    contact_phone: str,
    contact_email: str,
    bio: str = "",
) -> AdHubAdvertiserProfile:
    if not company_name.strip():
        raise ValueError("company_required")
    account.is_advertiser = True
    existing = account.advertiser
    if existing:
        existing.company_name = company_name.strip()
        existing.contact_name = contact_name.strip()
        existing.contact_phone = contact_phone.strip()
        existing.contact_email = contact_email.strip()
        existing.bio = bio.strip()
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(existing)
        return existing
    row = AdHubAdvertiserProfile(
        account_id=account.id,
        company_name=company_name.strip(),
        contact_name=contact_name.strip(),
        contact_phone=contact_phone.strip(),
        contact_email=contact_email.strip(),
        bio=bio.strip(),
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _adjust_reputation(db: Session, account_id: str, delta: int, reason: str) -> int:
    prof = db.get(AdHubPublisherProfile, account_id)
    if not prof:
        adv = db.get(AdHubAdvertiserProfile, account_id)
        if not adv:
            return 80
        adv.reputation_score = max(0, min(100, int(adv.reputation_score) + delta))
        db.add(AdHubReputationLog(account_id=account_id, delta=delta, reason=reason))
        return adv.reputation_score
    prof.reputation_score = max(0, min(100, int(prof.reputation_score) + delta))
    db.add(AdHubReputationLog(account_id=account_id, delta=delta, reason=reason))
    return prof.reputation_score


def list_publishers(
    db: Session, *, min_reputation: int = 0, limit: int = 50
) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubAccount)
        .join(AdHubPublisherProfile, AdHubPublisherProfile.account_id == AdHubAccount.id)
        .where(
            AdHubPublisherProfile.verify_status == "verified",
            AdHubPublisherProfile.reputation_score >= min_reputation,
        )
        .order_by(AdHubPublisherProfile.reputation_score.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    out: list[dict] = []
    for acc in rows:
        p = acc.publisher
        if not p:
            continue
        out.append(_publisher_public_dict(acc, p))
    return out


def list_advertisers(db: Session, *, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubAccount)
        .join(AdHubAdvertiserProfile, AdHubAdvertiserProfile.account_id == AdHubAccount.id)
        .where(AdHubAccount.is_advertiser.is_(True))
        .order_by(AdHubAdvertiserProfile.reputation_score.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    out: list[dict] = []
    for acc in rows:
        a = acc.advertiser
        if not a:
            continue
        out.append(_advertiser_public_dict(acc, a))
    return out


def get_publisher_public(db: Session, account_id: str) -> dict | None:
    acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id)
    if not acc or not acc.publisher or acc.publisher.verify_status != "verified":
        return None
    return _publisher_public_dict(acc, acc.publisher)


def get_advertiser_public(db: Session, account_id: str) -> dict | None:
    acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id)
    if not acc or not acc.advertiser:
        return None
    return _advertiser_public_dict(acc, acc.advertiser)


def _publisher_public_dict(acc: AdHubAccount, p: AdHubPublisherProfile) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": acc.id,
        "nickname": acc.nickname,
        "avatarUrl": acc.avatar_url,
        "realNameMasked": p.real_name[:1] + "**" if p.real_name else "",
        "reputationScore": int(p.reputation_score),
        "fraudFlags": int(p.fraud_flags),
        "contactPhone": p.contact_phone,
        "contactEmail": p.contact_email,
        "websiteUrl": p.website_url,
        "bio": p.bio,
        "verified": p.verify_status == "verified",
        "role": "publisher",
    }


def _advertiser_public_dict(acc: AdHubAccount, a: AdHubAdvertiserProfile) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": acc.id,
        "nickname": acc.nickname,
        "avatarUrl": acc.avatar_url,
        "companyName": a.company_name,
        "contactName": a.contact_name,
        "reputationScore": int(a.reputation_score),
        "contactPhone": a.contact_phone,
        "contactEmail": a.contact_email,
        "bio": a.bio,
        "role": "advertiser",
    }


def account_me_dict(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> dict:
    p = account.publisher
    a = account.advertiser
    qr = account.qr_slot
    return {
        "id": account.id,
        "nickname": account.nickname,
        "avatarUrl": account.avatar_url,
        "isPublisher": bool(account.is_publisher),
        "isAdvertiser": bool(account.is_advertiser),
        "publisher": {
            "verifyStatus": p.verify_status if p else "none",
            "realNameMasked": (p.real_name[:1] + "**") if p and p.real_name else "",
            "reputationScore": int(p.reputation_score) if p else 80,
            "fraudFlags": int(p.fraud_flags) if p else 0,
            "contactPhone": p.contact_phone if p else "",
            "contactEmail": p.contact_email if p else "",
            "websiteUrl": p.website_url if p else "",
            "bio": p.bio if p else "",
        },
        "advertiser": {
            "companyName": a.company_name if a else "",
            "contactName": a.contact_name if a else "",
            "reputationScore": int(a.reputation_score) if a else 80,
            "contactPhone": a.contact_phone if a else "",
            "contactEmail": a.contact_email if a else "",
            "bio": a.bio if a else "",
        }
        if a
        else None,
        "qrCode": qr.code if qr else None,
    }


def record_watch_complete(
    db: Session,
    *,
    qr_code: str,
    viewer_key: str,
    ip_address: str,
    duration_sec: int,
) -> tuple[bool, str, dict]:
    slot = get_qr_by_code(db, qr_code)
    if not slot:
        return False, "invalid_code", {}
    publisher_id = slot.account_id
    prof = db.get(AdHubPublisherProfile, publisher_id)
    if not prof or prof.verify_status != "verified":
        return False, "publisher_not_verified", {}

    suspicious = False
    if duration_sec < 25:
        suspicious = True
    since = _now() - timedelta(hours=1)
    recent_same_viewer = int(
        db.scalar(
            select(func.count(AdHubWatchEvent.id)).where(
                AdHubWatchEvent.qr_code == qr_code,
                AdHubWatchEvent.viewer_key == viewer_key,
                AdHubWatchEvent.completed.is_(True),
                AdHubWatchEvent.created_at >= since,
            )
        )
        or 0
    )
    if recent_same_viewer >= 5:
        suspicious = True

    evt = AdHubWatchEvent(
        qr_code=qr_code,
        publisher_account_id=publisher_id,
        viewer_key=viewer_key,
        ip_address=ip_address or "",
        duration_sec=duration_sec,
        completed=True,
        suspicious=suspicious,
    )
    db.add(evt)

    if suspicious:
        prof.fraud_flags = int(prof.fraud_flags) + 1
        score = _adjust_reputation(db, publisher_id, -8, "疑似刷量观看")
    else:
        score = _adjust_reputation(db, publisher_id, +1, "正常完成观看")

    db.commit()
    return True, "ok" if not suspicious else "suspicious", {
        "publisherReputation": score,
        "suspicious": suspicious,
    }


def create_cooperation(
    db: Session, *, from_id: str, to_id: str, message: str
) -> AdHubCooperationIntent:
    if from_id == to_id:
        raise ValueError("self")
    existing = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubCooperationIntent).where(
            AdHubCooperationIntent.from_account_id == from_id,
            AdHubCooperationIntent.to_account_id == to_id,
        )
    )
    if existing:
        existing.message = message.strip()
        existing.status = "pending"
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(existing)
        return existing
    row = AdHubCooperationIntent(
        from_account_id=from_id, to_account_id=to_id, message=message.strip(), status="pending"
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _thread_pair(a: str, b: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    return (a, b) if a < b else (b, a)


def open_chat_thread(db: Session, account_id: str, peer_id: str) -> AdHubChatThread:
    a, b = _thread_pair(account_id, peer_id)
    row = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubChatThread).where(
            AdHubChatThread.account_a_id == a, AdHubChatThread.account_b_id == b
        )
    )
    if row:
        return row
    row = AdHubChatThread(account_a_id=a, account_b_id=b)
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def list_chat_threads(db: Session, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubChatThread).where(
            or_(
                AdHubChatThread.account_a_id == account_id,
                AdHubChatThread.account_b_id == account_id,
            )
        ).order_by(AdHubChatThread.last_message_at.desc().nullslast())
    )
    out: list[dict] = []
    for t in rows:
        peer_id = t.account_b_id if t.account_a_id == account_id else t.account_a_id
        peer = db.get(AdHubAccount, peer_id)
        last = db.scalar(
            select(AdHubChatMessage)
            .where(AdHubChatMessage.thread_id == t.id)
            .order_by(AdHubChatMessage.created_at.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        out.append(
            {
                "threadId": t.id,
                "peerId": peer_id,
                "peerNickname": peer.nickname if peer else "",
                "peerAvatarUrl": peer.avatar_url if peer else "",
                "lastMessage": last.content if last else "",
                "lastMessageAt": last.created_at.isoformat() if last and last.created_at else "",
            }
        )
    return out


def list_chat_messages(db: Session, thread_id: str, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    thread = db.get(AdHubChatThread, thread_id)
    if not thread or account_id not in (thread.account_a_id, thread.account_b_id):
        return []
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubChatMessage)
        .where(AdHubChatMessage.thread_id == thread_id)
        .order_by(AdHubChatMessage.created_at.asc())
    )
    return [
        {
            "id": m.id,
            "senderId": m.sender_id,
            "content": m.content,
            "createdAt": m.created_at.isoformat() if m.created_at else "",
            "mine": m.sender_id == account_id,
        }
        for m in rows
    ]


def send_chat_message(db: Session, *, thread_id: str, sender_id: str, content: str) -> AdHubChatMessage:
    thread = db.get(AdHubChatThread, thread_id)
    if not thread or sender_id not in (thread.account_a_id, thread.account_b_id):
        raise ValueError("forbidden")
    text = content.strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    msg = AdHubChatMessage(thread_id=thread_id, sender_id=sender_id, content=text)
    thread.last_message_at = _now()
    db.add(msg)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(msg)
    return msg

# 扫码看广 · 产品设计（第一期）

## 定位

独立微信小程序：流量主（网站主）实名认证后获得**唯一专属二维码**，嵌入个人网站；访客扫码看广后，系统记录观看并维护流量主**信誉分**。广告商可注册、浏览流量主信誉并主动合作；双方可查看公开资料，通过**站内聊天 + 电话/邮箱**联系。

## 角色

| 角色 | 能力 |
|------|------|
| 流量主（Publisher） | 微信一键登录 → 实名认证 → 获取专属 QR → 维护联系方式与网站 |
| 广告商（Advertiser） | 注册企业资料 → 在合作广场筛选高信誉流量主 → 发起合作/聊天 |
| 访客 | 扫 QR 打开 H5 看广页，无需登录 |

## 信誉与反刷

- 初始信誉 80，范围 0–100
- 正常完播 +1；疑似刷量（完播过快、同设备 1h 内多次）-8 并标记
- 信誉越低，广告商在广场排序越靠后（后续可接「资源配额」）

- **小程序**：`D:\1code\H-builder-weixin-app\论文润色\扫码看广`
- **API**：`downAiGC` 后端 `/api/adhub/*`（与论文润色 Web 用户表隔离）
- **扫码落地页**：`/static/adhub-watch/index.html?code=xxx`

## 后续迭代

- 微信实人认证 API 对接（当前为表单 + 本地校验尾号）
- 激励视频广告 SDK
- WebSocket 实时聊天
- 网站主后台 webhook 发奖励

# 扫码看广 · 微信小程序

独立小程序：微信一键登录 → 实名认证 → 专属看广二维码 → 合作广场 / 聊天 / 广告商入驻。

## 开发

1. 用 HBuilderX 打开本目录
2. 修改 `common/config.js` 中的 `apiBase` 为你的后端地址
3. 微信小程序后台配置 **request 合法域名**（须 HTTPS；本地调试可开「不校验合法域名」）
4. 运行到微信开发者工具

## 后端

API 在 `downAiGC` 项目 `/api/adhub/*`，需先启动后端并执行迁移：

```bash
cd downAiGC/backend
python -m alembic upgrade head
uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

环境变量（见 `downAiGC/backend/.env.example`）：

- `ADHUB_WECHAT_APPID` / `ADHUB_WECHAT_SECRET` — 正式微信登录
- 未配置时，登录接口接受 `code=dev`（开发者工具联调）
- `ADHUB_PUBLIC_BASE` — 二维码 H5 落地页域名

## 页面结构

| 页面 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 登录 | 仅保留微信一键登录 |
| 首页 | 信誉与认证引导 |
| 我的二维码 | 实名后唯一专属码 |
| 合作广场 | 流量主 / 广告商互选 |
| 消息 | 站内聊天 + 详情页电话/邮箱 |
| 我的 | 资料与广告商入驻 |

`uni_modules/uni-id-pages` 仍保留在目录中但已不再引用，后续可手动删除以减小体积。

| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 微信登录 | `POST /api/adhub/auth/weixin` |

| 广告商入驻 | 注册后在广场展示 |

    apiRequest("/api/adhub/me")

## 这个地址是什么

截图里是 **uniCloud 服务空间「once」** 的配置：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| `https://api.next.bspapp.com` | uniCloud **云函数** 的统一请求入口 |
| `SpaceId` / `ClientSecret` | 小程序连 uniCloud 用的空间凭证 |
| 云存储域名 | 文件上传/下载，不是业务 API |

这是 DCloud 的 **Serverless 云函数** 平台，不是给你跑 `uvicorn` + FastAPI 的服务器。

---

## 和当前项目的关系

现在「扫码看广」的后端是：

- `扫码看广/server/` 里的 **Python FastAPI**
- 接口形如 `/api/adhub/auth/weixin`、`/api/adhub/me` 等
- 本地：`http://127.0.0.1:8001`

把 `config.js` 改成 `https://api.next.bspapp.com` **不会**自动有这些接口——云上没有部署我们的 Python 代码，请求会失败或打到别的云函数上。

---

## 你有三条路

### 1. 继续用独立 Python 后端（当前方案，推荐先这样）

本地开发：

```powershell
cd "D:\1code\H-builder-weixin-app\论文润色\扫码看广\server"
python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
```

上线：把 `server/` 部署到 **阿里云/腾讯云 轻量服务器**，`config.js` 和 `server/.env` 里填 HTTPS 域名即可。微信 AppID/Secret 只写在 `server/.env`。

### 2. 改用 uniCloud 做后端（要大改）

需要把登录、实名、二维码、信誉、聊天等 **全部重写成云函数**（Node.js），并接 uniCloud 数据库，工作量接近重做一套后端。原来的 `server/` 不能直接挂到 `api.next.bspapp.com`。

### 3. 混合（一般不推荐）

uniCloud 只做登录/存储，业务仍调自建 API，两套系统都要维护，复杂度高。

---

## 安全提醒

截图里含有 **ClientSecret**，不要提交到 Git 或发到公开地方。若已泄露，可在 uniCloud 控制台重置。

---

**结论**：`api.next.bspapp.com` 是 uniCloud 云函数网关，**不能**当作当前 Python 后端的启动地址。若你确定要走 uniCloud，可以说一下，我可以按云函数方案帮你规划迁移；若只想先跑通，继续用 `server/` + 8001 端口即可。

<script>
import { apiRequest, getToken } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return { me: null };
  },
  computed: {
    verifyLabel() {
      if (!this.me) return "-";
      return this.me.publisher.verifyStatus === "verified" ? "已认证" : "未认证";
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);

<script>
import { apiRequest, clearToken, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return { me: null, loggedIn: false };
  },
  computed: {
    avatarInitial() {
      const n = (this.me && this.me.nickname) || "用";
      return n.slice(0, 1);
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
    if (!this.loggedIn) {
      this.me = null;
      return;
    }
    apiRequest("/api/adhub/me")
      .then((d) => {
        this.me = d;
      })
      .catch(() => {
        this.me = null;
      });
  },
  methods: {
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    guard() {
      return requireLogin();
    },
    goVerify() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    goAdvertiser() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/advertiser/register" });
    },
    editContact() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.showModal({
        title: "联系电话",
        editable: true,
        placeholderText: "手机号",
        success: (res) => {
          if (!res.confirm) return;
          const phone = res.content || "";
          uni.showModal({
            title: "联系邮箱",
            editable: true,
            success: (r2) => {
              if (!r2.confirm) return;
              apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/publisher", {
                method: "PUT",
                data: {
                  contactPhone: phone,
                  contactEmail: r2.content || "",
                  websiteUrl: "",
                  bio: ""
                }
              }).then(() => {
                uni.showToast({ title: "已保存", icon: "success" });
                this.onShow();
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    },
    logout() {
      clearToken();
      this.me = null;
      this.loggedIn = false;
      uni.reLaunch({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<script>
import { apiRequest, setToken } from "@/common/api.js";

export default {
  data() {

    onWeixinLogin() {
      this.loading = true;
      this.err = "";
      uni.login({
        provider: "weixin",
        success: (loginRes) => {
          const code = loginRes.code || "dev";
          apiRequest("/api/adhub/auth/weixin", {

            data: { code, nickname: "", avatarUrl: "" }

            .catch((e) => {
              this.err = e.detail || "登录失败";

              this.loading = false;

        fail: () => {

};

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return { threadId: "", messages: [], draft: "", scrollInto: "" };
  },
  onLoad(q) {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    this.threadId = q.threadId || "";
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    load() {
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/chat/threads/${this.threadId}/messages`).then((d) => {
        this.messages = d.items || [];
        const last = this.messages[this.messages.length - 1];
        if (last) this.scrollInto = "m-" + last.id;
      });
    },
    send() {
      const text = this.draft.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/chat/threads/${this.threadId}/messages`, {
        method: "POST",
        data: { content: text }
      }).then(() => {
        this.draft = "";
        this.load();
      });
    }
  }
};

def create_campaign(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    title: str,
    description: str = "",
    duration_sec: int = 30,
    publisher_reward_points: int = 1888,
) -> AdHubCampaign:
    if not account.is_advertiser or not account.advertiser:
        raise ValueError("not_advertiser")
    title = title.strip()
    if len(title) < 2:
        raise ValueError("title_required")
    duration_sec = max(10, min(120, int(duration_sec)))
    publisher_reward_points = max(0, min(99999, int(publisher_reward_points)))
    row = AdHubCampaign(
        advertiser_account_id=account.id,
        title=title,
        description=description.strip(),
        duration_sec=duration_sec,
        publisher_reward_points=publisher_reward_points,
        status="active",
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _campaign_dict(c: AdHubCampaign, acc: AdHubAccount | None = None) -> dict:
    adv = acc or (c.advertiser if hasattr(c, "advertiser") else None)
    company = ""
    if adv and adv.advertiser:
        company = adv.advertiser.company_name
    elif adv:
        company = adv.nickname
    return {
        "id": c.id,
        "title": c.title,
        "description": c.description,
        "durationSec": int(c.duration_sec),
        "publisherRewardPoints": int(c.publisher_reward_points),
        "status": c.status,
        "viewsTotal": int(c.views_total),
        "viewsValid": int(c.views_valid),
        "viewsSuspicious": int(c.views_suspicious),
        "advertiserId": c.advertiser_account_id,
        "companyName": company,
        "createdAt": c.created_at.isoformat() if c.created_at else "",
    }


def list_market_campaigns(db: Session, *, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubCampaign)
        .where(AdHubCampaign.status == "active")
        .order_by(AdHubCampaign.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    out: list[dict] = []
    for c in rows:
        acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, c.advertiser_account_id)
        out.append(_campaign_dict(c, acc))
    return out


def list_advertiser_campaigns(db: Session, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubCampaign)
        .where(AdHubCampaign.advertiser_account_id == account_id)
        .order_by(AdHubCampaign.created_at.desc())
    )
    acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id)
    return [_campaign_dict(c, acc) for c in rows]


def get_campaign_for_advertiser(db: Session, campaign_id: str, account_id: str) -> AdHubCampaign | None:
    row = db.get(AdHubCampaign, campaign_id)
    if not row or row.advertiser_account_id != account_id:
        return None
    return row


def get_campaign_stats(db: Session, campaign_id: str, account_id: str) -> dict | None:
    c = get_campaign_for_advertiser(db, campaign_id, account_id)
    if not c:
        return None
    since = _now() - timedelta(hours=24)
    recent = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubWatchEvent)
        .where(
            AdHubWatchEvent.campaign_id == campaign_id,
            AdHubWatchEvent.created_at >= since,
        )
        .order_by(AdHubWatchEvent.created_at.desc())
        .limit(20)
    )
    events = [
        {
            "id": e.id,
            "qrCode": e.qr_code,
            "durationSec": int(e.duration_sec),
            "suspicious": bool(e.suspicious),
            "publisherRewardPoints": int(e.publisher_reward_points),
            "createdAt": e.created_at.isoformat() if e.created_at else "",
        }
        for e in recent
    ]
    linked = int(
        db.scalar(
            select(func.count(AdHubQrCampaignLink.id)).where(
                AdHubQrCampaignLink.campaign_id == campaign_id,
                AdHubQrCampaignLink.active.is_(True),
            )
        )
        or 0
    )
    base = _campaign_dict(c, db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id))
    base["linkedQrCount"] = linked
    base["recentEvents"] = events
    return base


def attach_campaign_to_qr(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount, campaign_id: str) -> AdHubQrCampaignLink:
    prof = account.publisher
    slot = account.qr_slot
    if not prof or prof.verify_status != "verified" or not slot:
        raise ValueError("qr_not_ready")
    campaign = db.get(AdHubCampaign, campaign_id)
    if not campaign or campaign.status != "active":
        raise ValueError("campaign_not_found")
    existing = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubQrCampaignLink).where(
            AdHubQrCampaignLink.qr_code == slot.code,
            AdHubQrCampaignLink.campaign_id == campaign_id,
        )
    )
    if existing:
        existing.active = True
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(existing)
        return existing
    row = AdHubQrCampaignLink(qr_code=slot.code, campaign_id=campaign_id, active=True)
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def list_qr_campaign_links(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> list[dict]:
    slot = account.qr_slot
    if not slot:
        return []
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubQrCampaignLink)
        .where(AdHubQrCampaignLink.qr_code == slot.code, AdHubQrCampaignLink.active.is_(True))
        .order_by(AdHubQrCampaignLink.created_at.desc())
    )
    out: list[dict] = []
    for link in rows:
        c = db.get(AdHubCampaign, link.campaign_id)
        if not c:
            continue
        acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, c.advertiser_account_id)
        item = _campaign_dict(c, acc)
        item["linkId"] = link.id
        out.append(item)
    return out


def get_publisher_revenue_preview(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> dict:
    slot = account.qr_slot
    if not slot:
        return {"totalRewardPoints": 0, "validViews": 0, "suspiciousViews": 0, "recent": []}
    since = _now() - timedelta(days=7)
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubWatchEvent)
        .where(
            AdHubWatchEvent.publisher_account_id == account.id,
            AdHubWatchEvent.completed.is_(True),
            AdHubWatchEvent.created_at >= since,
        )
        .order_by(AdHubWatchEvent.created_at.desc())
        .limit(30)
    )
    events = list(rows)
    valid = [e for e in events if not e.suspicious]
    suspicious = [e for e in events if e.suspicious]
    return {
        "totalRewardPoints": sum(int(e.publisher_reward_points) for e in valid),
        "validViews": len(valid),
        "suspiciousViews": len(suspicious),
        "recent": [
            {
                "campaignId": e.campaign_id,
                "rewardPoints": int(e.publisher_reward_points),
                "suspicious": bool(e.suspicious),
                "createdAt": e.created_at.isoformat() if e.created_at else "",
            }
            for e in events[:10]
        ],
    }


def get_watch_session(db: Session, qr_code: str) -> dict | None:
    slot = get_qr_by_code(db, qr_code)
    if not slot:
        return None
    prof = db.get(AdHubPublisherProfile, slot.account_id)
    if not prof or prof.verify_status != "verified":

    link = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubQrCampaignLink)
        .where(AdHubQrCampaignLink.qr_code == qr_code, AdHubQrCampaignLink.active.is_(True))
        .order_by(AdHubQrCampaignLink.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    campaign = None
    if link:
        campaign = db.get(AdHubCampaign, link.campaign_id)
        if not campaign or campaign.status != "active":
            campaign = None
    duration = int(campaign.duration_sec) if campaign else 30
    reward = int(campaign.publisher_reward_points) if campaign else 0
    return {
        "code": qr_code,
        "durationSec": duration,

        "campaign": _campaign_dict(campaign, db.get(AdHubAccount, campaign.advertiser_account_id))
        if campaign

--

<template>
  <view class="pp-page">
    <view class="pp-seg">
      <text :class="['pp-seg-item', tab === 'publishers' ? 'active' : '']" @click="tab = 'publishers'">流量主</text>
      <text :class="['pp-seg-item', tab === 'advertisers' ? 'active' : '']" @click="tab = 'advertisers'">广告商</text>
      <text :class="['pp-seg-item', tab === 'campaigns' ? 'active' : '']" @click="tab = 'campaigns'">推广广告</text>
    </view>

    <view v-if="tab === 'publishers'" class="filter-row">
      <text class="pp-sub">最低信誉 {{ minRep }}/100</text>
      <slider :value="minRep" min="0" max="100" activeColor="#111" backgroundColor="#e5e5e5" block-color="#111" show-value @change="onRepChange" />
    </view>

    <view v-if="tab === 'campaigns' && me && me.isAdvertiser" class="pp-card">
      <text class="pp-title">发布 30 秒广告</text>
      <input class="pp-input" v-model="newTitle" placeholder="广告标题" />
      <input class="pp-input" v-model="newDesc" placeholder="广告说明（可选）" />
      <button class="pp-btn" :loading="creating" @click="publishCampaign">发布到广场</button>
    </view>

    <view v-if="tab === 'campaigns'" class="pp-card item" v-for="item in campaignList" :key="item.id">
      <view class="item-head">
        <text class="name">{{ item.title }}</text>
        <text class="pp-tag">{{ item.durationSec }}秒</text>
      </view>
      <text class="pp-sub">{{ item.description || item.companyName || "推广广告" }}</text>
      <text class="pp-sub">流量主收益预览 {{ item.publisherRewardPoints }} 积分 · 有效观看 {{ item.viewsValid }}</text>
      <button v-if="tab === 'campaigns'" class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost attach-btn" @click="attachCampaign(item)">加单到我的二维码</button>
    </view>

    <view v-if="tab !== 'campaigns'" class="pp-card item" v-for="item in list" :key="item.id" @click="openDetail(item)">
      <view class="item-head">
        <text class="name">{{ displayName(item) }}</text>
        <text class="pp-rep">{{ formatRep(item.reputationScore) }}</text>
      </view>
      <text class="pp-sub bio">{{ item.bio || "暂无简介" }}</text>
    </view>

    <view v-if="tab === 'campaigns' && !campaignList.length" class="pp-card"><text class="pp-sub">暂无推广广告，广告商可在此发布。</text></view>
    <view v-if="tab !== 'campaigns' && !list.length" class="pp-card"><text class="pp-sub">暂无数据</text></view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return { tab: "publishers", list: [], campaignList: [], minRep: 0, me: null, newTitle: "", newDesc: "", creating: false };
  },
  onShow() {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    apiRequest("/api/adhub/me").then((d) => { this.me = d; }).catch(() => { this.me = null; });
    this.load();
  },
  watch: {
    tab() {
      this.load();
    }
  },
  methods: {
    formatRep(score) {
      return formatReputation(score);
    },
    onRepChange(e) {
      this.minRep = e.detail.value;
      this.load();
    },
    load() {
      if (this.tab === "campaigns") {
        apiRequest("/api/adhub/market/campaigns").then((d) => {
          this.campaignList = d.items || [];
        });
        return;
      }
      const path =
        this.tab === "publishers"
          ? `/api/adhub/market/publishers?minReputation=${this.minRep}`
          : "/api/adhub/market/advertisers";
      apiRequest(path).then((d) => {
        this.list = d.items || [];
      });
    },
    displayName(item) {
      if (item.companyName) return item.companyName;
      return item.nickname || item.realNameMasked || "用户";
    },
    openDetail(item) {
      const role = item.role || (this.tab === "advertisers" ? "advertiser" : "publisher");
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/detail?id=${item.id}&role=${role}` });
    },
    publishCampaign() {
      const title = this.newTitle.trim();
      if (title.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入标题", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.creating = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { title, description: this.newDesc, durationSec: 30, publisherRewardPoints: 1888 }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "已发布", icon: "success" });
          this.newTitle = "";
          this.newDesc = "";
          this.load();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发布失败", icon: "none" });
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.creating = false;
        });
    },
    attachCampaign(item) {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: item.id }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "已加单到二维码", icon: "success" });
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          const msg = String(e.detail || "");
          if (msg.includes("qr_not_ready") || msg.includes("实名")) {
            uni.showModal({ title: "提示", content: "请先完成实名认证并生成专属二维码", showCancel: false });
          } else {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "加单失败", icon: "none" });
          }
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

## 已实现能力

### 扫码看广后端（8001）
- **推广广告**：广告商发布 30 秒倒计时广告（默认流量主收益预览 1888 积分）
- **广场 → 推广广告**：浏览、发布、加单到专属二维码
- **观看页**：`/static/adhub-watch/index.html?code=xxx` 会拉取挂载广告并倒计时，完成后返回收益预览
- **实时推广状态**：`/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns/{id}/stats`（近 24h 观看事件）
- **流量主收益预览**：`/api/adhub/me/revenue-preview`
- **Web 测试登录**：`/api/adhub/web/dev-login`（`DEV_LOGIN=1` 时可用）

### 小程序
- 广场新增 **「推广广告」** 标签

- 广告商可进入 **推广状态** 页（3 秒刷新）

### downAiGC
- 后端 **代理** `/api/adhub/*` → `http://127.0.0.1:8001`（`adhub_proxy.py`）
- 控制台新增 **扫码看广联调台**：`/console/wallet/adhub`
- 积分页增加入口链接

def get_campaign_public(db: Session, campaign_id: str) -> dict | None:
    c = db.get(AdHubCampaign, campaign_id)
    if not c or c.status != "active":
        return None
    acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, c.advertiser_account_id)

    if acc and acc.advertiser:
        data["advertiser"] = _advertiser_public_dict(acc, acc.advertiser)

def get_publisher_revenue_preview(db: Session, account: AdHubAccount) -> dict:
    slot = account.qr_slot
    if not slot:
        return {
            "validPromoCount": 0,
            "totalRevenueFen": 0,
            "totalRevenueYuan": 0,
            "totalRevenueDisplay": "¥0.00",
            "recent": [],
        }
    since = _now() - timedelta(days=7)
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(AdHubWatchEvent)
        .where(
            AdHubWatchEvent.publisher_account_id == account.id,
            AdHubWatchEvent.completed.is_(True),
            AdHubWatchEvent.suspicious.is_(False),
            AdHubWatchEvent.created_at >= since,
        )
        .order_by(AdHubWatchEvent.created_at.desc())
        .limit(100)
    )
    events = list(rows)
    total_fen = 0
    recent: list[dict] = []
    for e in events:
        unit_fen = 15
        title = ""
        if e.campaign_id:
            camp = db.get(AdHubCampaign, e.campaign_id)
            if camp:
                unit_fen = int(camp.unit_price_fen)
                title = camp.title
        total_fen += unit_fen
        if len(recent) < 10:
            recent.append(
                {
                    "campaignId": e.campaign_id,
                    "campaignTitle": title,
                    "unitPriceYuan": round(unit_fen / 100, 2),
                    "revenueYuan": round(unit_fen / 100, 2),
                    "createdAt": e.created_at.isoformat() if e.created_at else "",
                }
            )
    yuan = round(total_fen / 100, 2)
    return {
        "validPromoCount": len(events),
        "totalRevenueFen": total_fen,
        "totalRevenueYuan": yuan,
        "totalRevenueDisplay": f"¥{yuan:.2f}",
        "recent": recent,
    }

import { formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      code: "",
      session: null,
      left: 30,
      msg: "",
      msgClass: "",
      err: "",
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    campaignTitle() {
      if (this.session && this.session.campaign) return this.session.campaign.title;
      return "观看广告";
    },
    campaignDesc() {
      if (this.session && this.session.campaign) return this.session.campaign.description || "";
      return "默认 30 秒倒计时";
    },
    unitPriceText() {
      if (!this.session || !this.session.campaign) return "";
      const y = this.session.campaign.unitPriceYuan;
      return y ? `有效观看预计收益 ${formatYuan(y)} / 次` : "";
    }
  },
  onLoad(q) {
    this.code = (q.code || "").trim();
    if (!this.code) {
      this.err = "缺少二维码参数";
      return;
    }
    this.loadSession();
  },
  onUnload() {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
  },
  methods: {
    loadSession() {
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/watch/session?code=${encodeURIComponent(this.code)}`, { auth: false })
        .then((d) => {
          this.session = d;
          this.left = d.durationSec || 30;
          this.startTimer();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.err = e.detail || "无法加载";
        });
    },
    startTimer() {
      if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
      this.timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (this.left <= 1) {
          clearInterval(this.timer);
          this.left = 0;
          this.finish();
          return;
        }
        this.left -= 1;
      }, 1000);
    },
    finish() {
      this.msg = "正在提交…";
      const body = {
        code: this.code,
        viewerKey: "mp_preview_" + Date.now(),
        durationSec: this.session.durationSec || 30
      };
      if (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.id) {
        body.campaignId = this.session.campaign.id;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/watch/complete", { method: "POST", auth: false, data: body })
        .then((d) => {
          if (d.suspicious) {
            this.msgClass = "warn";
            this.msg = "已记录，本次标记为可疑观看";
          } else {
            this.msgClass = "ok";
            const y = d.unitPriceYuan != null ? d.unitPriceYuan : (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.unitPriceYuan);
            this.msg = y ? `观看完成，收益预览 ${formatYuan(y)}` : "观看完成";
          }
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.msgClass = "err";
          this.msg = e.detail || "提交失败";
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

    fetchMeCached().then((d) => { this.me = d; });

};

        return;

      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns", {

        .then(() => {

          this.newTitle = "";
          this.newDesc = "";

        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发布失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.creating = false; });

      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/advertiser/stats?id=${item.id}` });
    },
    attachCampaign(item) {

        .then(() => uni.showToast({ title: "已加单到二维码", icon: "success" }))

};

      err: "",

    onAvatarTap() {

      uni.showModal({

def update_account_profile(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    nickname: str | None = None,
    avatar_url: str | None = None,
) -> AdHubAccount:
    if nickname is not None:
        account.nickname = nickname.strip()[:100]

    db.commit()

def _event_unit_fen(db: Session, event: AdHubWatchEvent) -> int:
    if event.campaign_id:
        camp = db.get(AdHubCampaign, event.campaign_id)
        if camp:
            return int(camp.unit_price_fen)
    return 15


def _advertiser_display_name(db: Session, account_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    acc = db.get(AdHubAccount, account_id)
    if not acc:
        return "", "未知广告商"
    adv = acc.advertiser
    name = (adv.company_name if adv and adv.company_name else acc.nickname) or "广告商"
    return acc.id, name


def get_account_ledger(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    include_income: bool = True,
    include_expense: bool = True,
    limit: int = 200,
) -> dict:
    items: list[dict] = []
    total_income_fen = 0
    total_expense_fen = 0

    if include_income:
        income_rows = db.scalars(
            select(AdHubWatchEvent)
            .where(
                AdHubWatchEvent.publisher_account_id == account.id,
                AdHubWatchEvent.completed.is_(True),
                AdHubWatchEvent.suspicious.is_(False),
            )
            .order_by(AdHubWatchEvent.created_at.desc())
        )
        for e in income_rows:
            unit_fen = _event_unit_fen(db, e)
            total_income_fen += unit_fen
            adv_id, adv_name = ("", "平台推广")
            if e.campaign_id:
                camp = db.get(AdHubCampaign, e.campaign_id)
                if camp:
                    adv_id, adv_name = _advertiser_display_name(db, camp.advertiser_account_id)
            created = e.created_at
            row = {
                "id": e.id,
                "type": "income",
                "amountFen": unit_fen,
                "amountYuan": round(unit_fen / 100, 2),
                "advertiserId": adv_id,
                "advertiserName": adv_name,
                "date": created.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if created else "",
                "createdAt": created.isoformat() if created else "",
            }
            if len(items) < limit or not include_expense:
                items.append(row)
            elif include_expense:
                items.append(row)

    if include_expense and account.advertiser:
        campaign_ids = list(
            db.scalars(
                select(AdHubCampaign.id).where(AdHubCampaign.advertiser_account_id == account.id)
            )
        )
        if campaign_ids:
            expense_rows = db.scalars(
                select(AdHubWatchEvent)
                .where(
                    AdHubWatchEvent.campaign_id.in_(campaign_ids),
                    AdHubWatchEvent.completed.is_(True),
                    AdHubWatchEvent.suspicious.is_(False),
                )
                .order_by(AdHubWatchEvent.created_at.desc())
            )
            adv_id, adv_name = _advertiser_display_name(db, account.id)
            for e in expense_rows:
                unit_fen = _event_unit_fen(db, e)
                total_expense_fen += unit_fen
                created = e.created_at
                row = {
                    "id": f"exp-{e.id}",
                    "type": "expense",
                    "amountFen": unit_fen,
                    "amountYuan": round(unit_fen / 100, 2),
                    "advertiserId": adv_id,
                    "advertiserName": adv_name,
                    "date": created.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if created else "",
                    "createdAt": created.isoformat() if created else "",
                }
                items.append(row)

    items.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("createdAt") or "", reverse=True)
    if limit > 0:
        items = items[:limit]

    income_yuan = round(total_income_fen / 100, 2)
    expense_yuan = round(total_expense_fen / 100, 2)
    return {
        "totalIncomeYuan": income_yuan,
        "totalExpenseYuan": expense_yuan,
        "totalIncomeDisplay": f"¥{income_yuan:.2f}",
        "totalExpenseDisplay": f"¥{expense_yuan:.2f}",
        "items": items,
    }

<template>

    <view class="profile-card" v-if="me">

          hover-class="profile-avatar-btn--pressed"
          hover-start-time="0"
          hover-stay-time="80"
          open-type="chooseAvatar"
          @tap="onAvatarTap"
          @chooseavatar="onChooseAvatar"
          @error="onAvatarError"
        >
          <image v-if="me.avatarUrl" class="profile-avatar-img" :src="me.avatarUrl" mode="aspectFill" />
          <view v-else class="profile-avatar-fallback">{{ avatarInitial }}</view>
        </button>

        <view class="profile-mid">
          <text class="profile-nick" @click="editNickname">{{ me.nickname || "未设置昵称" }}</text>

          <text v-if="phoneDisplay" class="profile-phone">{{ phoneDisplay }}</text>
        </view>

        <view class="profile-stats">
          <view class="stat-line" @click="goLedger">
            <text class="stat-label">累计收益</text>
            <text class="stat-value stat-value--income">{{ incomeDisplay }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="stat-line" @click="goLedger">
            <text class="stat-label">累计支出</text>
            <text class="stat-value stat-value--expense">{{ expenseDisplay }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>

      <text class="pp-sub">登录后可管理二维码、信誉与联系方式</text>

    </view>

      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goVerify">实名认证</view>
      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goQr">我的二维码</view>

      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goContact">编辑联系方式</view>

<script>
import { apiRequest, clearToken, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

function stripPhonePrefix(phone) {
  const p = (phone || "").trim();
  if (!p) return "";
  return p.replace(/^\+86/, "");
}

function displayPhone(phone) {
  const digits = stripPhonePrefix(phone);
  if (!digits) return "";
  return digits.length === 11 ? digits : phone;
}

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      me: null,
      loggedIn: false,
      incomeDisplay: "¥0.00",
      expenseDisplay: "¥0.00"
    };
  },
  computed: {
    avatarInitial() {
      const n = (this.me && this.me.nickname) || "用";
      return n.slice(0, 1);
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    },
    phoneDisplay() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.publisher) return "";
      const p = displayPhone(this.me.publisher.contactPhone);
      return p ? `手机 ${p}` : "";
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.refreshPage();
  },
  methods: {
    refreshPage() {
      this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
      if (!this.loggedIn) {
        this.me = null;
        return;
      }
      fetchMeCached(true)
        .then((d) => {
          this.me = d;
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.me = null;
        });
      this.loadLedgerSummary();
    },
    loadLedgerSummary() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/ledger?types=income,expense")
        .then((d) => {
          this.incomeDisplay = d.totalIncomeDisplay || formatYuan(0);
          this.expenseDisplay = d.totalExpenseDisplay || formatYuan(0);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.incomeDisplay = formatYuan(0);
          this.expenseDisplay = formatYuan(0);
        });
    },
    onAvatarTap() {
      if (this._avatarPicking) return;
      this._avatarPicking = true;
      clearTimeout(this._avatarPickTimer);
      this._avatarPickTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._avatarPicking = false;
      }, 4000);
    },
    onChooseAvatar(e) {
      this._avatarPicking = false;
      clearTimeout(this._avatarPickTimer);
      const url = e.detail && e.detail.avatarUrl;
      if (!url) return;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/profile", {
        method: "PUT",
        data: { nickname: this.me.nickname || "", avatarUrl: url }
      })
        .then((d) => {
          clearMeCache();
          this.me = d;
          uni.showToast({ title: "头像已更新", icon: "success" });
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          uni.showToast({ title: err.detail || "头像保存失败", icon: "none" });
        });
    },
    onAvatarError() {
      this._avatarPicking = false;
      clearTimeout(this._avatarPickTimer);
    },
    editNickname() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.showModal({
        title: "修改昵称",
        editable: true,
        placeholderText: "请输入昵称",
        content: this.me.nickname || "",
        success: (res) => {
          if (!res.confirm) return;
          const nick = (res.content || "").trim();
          if (!nick) {
            uni.showToast({ title: "昵称不能为空", icon: "none" });
            return;
          }
          apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/profile", {
            method: "PUT",
            data: { nickname: nick, avatarUrl: this.me.avatarUrl || "" }
          })
            .then((d) => {
              clearMeCache();
              this.me = d;
              uni.showToast({ title: "昵称已更新", icon: "success" });
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              uni.showToast({ title: err.detail || "保存失败", icon: "none" });
            });
        }
      });
    },
    openSettings() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.showActionSheet({
        itemList: ["编辑联系方式", "退出登录"],
        success: (res) => {
          if (res.tapIndex === 0) this.goContact();
          if (res.tapIndex === 1) this.logout();
        }
      });
    },
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    guard() {
      return requireLogin();
    },
    goVerify() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    goAdvertiser() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/advertiser/register" });
    },
    goContact() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/mine/contact" });
    },
    goLedger() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/mine/ledger" });
    },
    logout() {
      clearMeCache();
      clearToken();
      this.me = null;
      this.loggedIn = false;
      uni.reLaunch({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

function stripPhonePrefix(phone) {
  return (phone || "").trim().replace(/^\+86/, "");
}

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      phone: "",
      email: "",
      websiteUrl: "",
      bio: "",
      saving: false,
      err: ""
    };
  },
  onLoad() {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    fetchMeCached(true)
      .then((me) => {
        const pub = me.publisher || {};
        this.phone = stripPhonePrefix(pub.contactPhone);
        this.email = pub.contactEmail || "";
        this.websiteUrl = pub.websiteUrl || "";
        this.bio = pub.bio || "";
      })
      .catch(() => {
        this.err = "无法加载联系方式";
      });
  },
  methods: {
    onPhoneInput(e) {
      const raw = (e.detail && e.detail.value) || "";
      this.phone = raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 11);
    },
    validatePhone(phone) {
      if (!phone) return true;
      return /^1\d{10}$/.test(phone);
    },
    normalizePhoneForSave(phone) {
      if (!phone) return "";
      return `+86${phone}`;
    },
    save() {
      const phone = (this.phone || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
      if (phone && !this.validatePhone(phone)) {
        this.err = "请填写正确的11位中国大陆手机号";
        return;
      }
      this.saving = true;
      this.err = "";
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/publisher", {
        method: "PUT",
        data: {
          contactPhone: this.normalizePhoneForSave(phone),
          contactEmail: (this.email || "").trim(),
          websiteUrl: this.websiteUrl,
          bio: this.bio
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          clearMeCache();
          uni.showToast({ title: "已保存", icon: "success" });
          setTimeout(() => uni.navigateBack(), 400);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.err = e.detail || "保存失败";
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.saving = false;
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      filterIncome: true,
      filterExpense: true,
      items: [],
      incomeDisplay: "¥0.00",
      expenseDisplay: "¥0.00",
      loading: true
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredItems() {
      return this.items.filter((item) => {
        if (item.type === "income") return this.filterIncome;
        if (item.type === "expense") return this.filterExpense;
        return true;
      });
    }
  },
  onLoad() {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    typesParam() {
      const parts = [];
      if (this.filterIncome) parts.push("income");
      if (this.filterExpense) parts.push("expense");
      return parts.length ? parts.join(",") : "income,expense";
    },
    load() {
      this.loading = true;
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/me/ledger?types=${this.typesParam()}`)
        .then((d) => {
          this.items = d.items || [];
          this.incomeDisplay = d.totalIncomeDisplay || formatYuan(0);
          this.expenseDisplay = d.totalExpenseDisplay || formatYuan(0);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.items = [];
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.loading = false;
        });
    },
    toggleIncome() {
      if (this.filterIncome && !this.filterExpense) return;
      this.filterIncome = !this.filterIncome;
      this.load();
    },
    toggleExpense() {
      if (this.filterExpense && !this.filterIncome) return;
      this.filterExpense = !this.filterExpense;
      this.load();
    },
    amountText(item) {
      const prefix = item.type === "income" ? "+" : "-";
      return `${prefix}${formatYuan(item.amountYuan)}`;
    },
    openAdvertiser(id) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/detail?id=${id}&role=advertiser` });
    }
  }
};

        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.loading = false;
        });
    },
    toggleIncome() {
      if (this.filterIncome && !this.filterExpense) return;
      this.filterIncome = !this.filterIncome;
    },
    toggleExpense() {
      if (this.filterExpense && !this.filterIncome) return;
      this.filterExpense = !this.filterExpense;
    },
    amountText(item) {

<template>
  <view class="pp-page">
    <view class="profile-card" v-if="me">
      <view class="profile-settings" @click="openSettings">
        <text class="settings-icon">⚙</text>
        <text class="settings-text">设置</text>
      </view>
      <view class="profile-main">
        <button
          class="profile-avatar-btn"
          hover-class="profile-avatar-btn--pressed"
          hover-start-time="0"
          hover-stay-time="80"
          open-type="chooseAvatar"
          @chooseavatar="onChooseAvatar"
          @error="onAvatarError"
        >
          <image v-if="me.avatarUrl" class="profile-avatar-img" :src="me.avatarUrl" mode="aspectFill" />
          <view v-else class="profile-avatar-fallback">{{ avatarInitial }}</view>
        </button>

        <view class="profile-mid">
          <text class="profile-nick" @click="editNickname">{{ me.nickname || "未设置昵称" }}</text>
          <text class="profile-rep">信誉值 {{ repText }}</text>
          <text v-if="phoneDisplay" class="profile-phone">{{ phoneDisplay }}</text>
        </view>

        <view class="profile-stats">
          <view class="stat-line" @click="goLedger">

            <text class="stat-value stat-value--income">{{ incomeDisplay }}</text>
          </view>

            <text class="stat-label">累计支出</text>
            <text class="stat-value stat-value--expense">{{ expenseDisplay }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="pp-card" v-else>
      <text class="pp-sub">登录后可管理二维码、信誉与联系方式</text>
      <button class="pp-btn" @click="goLogin">微信一键登录</button>
    </view>

    <view class="pp-card">
      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goVerify">实名认证</view>
      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goQr">我的二维码</view>

      <view class="pp-menu-item" @click="goContact">编辑联系方式</view>
    </view>

    <button v-if="loggedIn" class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost" @click="logout">退出登录</button>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { apiRequest, clearToken, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

function stripPhonePrefix(phone) {
  const p = (phone || "").trim();
  if (!p) return "";
  return p.replace(/^\+86/, "");
}

function displayPhone(phone) {
  const digits = stripPhonePrefix(phone);
  if (!digits) return "";
  return digits.length === 11 ? digits : phone;
}

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      me: null,
      loggedIn: false,
      incomeDisplay: "¥0.00",
      expenseDisplay: "¥0.00",
      savingProfile: false
    };
  },
  computed: {
    avatarInitial() {
      const n = (this.me && this.me.nickname) || "用";
      return n.slice(0, 1);
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    },
    phoneDisplay() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.publisher) return "";
      const p = displayPhone(this.me.publisher.contactPhone);
      return p ? `手机 ${p}` : "";
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.refreshPage();
  },
  methods: {
    refreshPage() {
      this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
      if (!this.loggedIn) {
        this.me = null;
        return;
      }
      fetchMeCached(true)
        .then((d) => {
          this.me = d;
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.me = null;
        });
      this.loadLedgerSummary();
    },
    loadLedgerSummary() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/ledger?types=income,expense")
        .then((d) => {
          this.incomeDisplay = d.totalIncomeDisplay || formatYuan(0);
          this.expenseDisplay = d.totalExpenseDisplay || formatYuan(0);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.incomeDisplay = formatYuan(0);
          this.expenseDisplay = formatYuan(0);
        });
    },
    onChooseAvatar(e) {
      if (this.savingProfile) return;
      const url = e.detail && e.detail.avatarUrl;
      if (!url || !this.me) return;
      this.savingProfile = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/profile", {
        method: "PUT",
        data: { nickname: this.me.nickname || "", avatarUrl: url }
      })
        .then((d) => {
          clearMeCache();
          this.me = d;
          uni.showToast({ title: "头像已更新", icon: "success" });
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          uni.showToast({ title: err.detail || "头像保存失败", icon: "none" });
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.savingProfile = false;
        });
    },
    onAvatarError() {
      this.savingProfile = false;
    },
    editNickname() {
      if (!this.guard() || this.savingProfile) return;
      uni.showModal({
        title: "修改昵称",
        editable: true,
        placeholderText: "请输入昵称",
        success: (res) => {
          if (!res.confirm) return;
          const nick = (res.content || "").trim();
          if (!nick) {
            uni.showToast({ title: "昵称不能为空", icon: "none" });
            return;
          }
          this.savingProfile = true;
          apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/profile", {
            method: "PUT",
            data: { nickname: nick, avatarUrl: this.me.avatarUrl || "" }
          })
            .then((d) => {
              clearMeCache();
              this.me = d;
              uni.showToast({ title: "昵称已更新", icon: "success" });
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              uni.showToast({ title: err.detail || "保存失败", icon: "none" });
            })
            .finally(() => {
              this.savingProfile = false;
            });
        }
      });
    },
    openSettings() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.showActionSheet({
        itemList: ["编辑联系方式", "退出登录"],
        success: (res) => {
          if (res.tapIndex === 0) this.goContact();
          if (res.tapIndex === 1) this.logout();
        }
      });
    },
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    guard() {
      return requireLogin();
    },
    goVerify() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    goAdvertiser() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/advertiser/register" });
    },
    goContact() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/mine/contact" });
    },
    goLedger() {
      if (!this.guard()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/mine/ledger" });
    },
    logout() {
      clearMeCache();
      clearToken();
      this.me = null;
      this.loggedIn = false;
      uni.reLaunch({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<script>
import config from "@/common/config.js";
import { apiRequest, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { CHAT_EMOJIS } from "@/common/emojis.js";
import { peerAvatarInitial } from "@/common/chatFormat.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      threadId: "",
      peerId: "",
      peerName: "",
      peerAvatar: "",
      messages: [],
      draft: "",
      scrollInto: "",
      showEmoji: false,
      sending: false,
      emojis: CHAT_EMOJIS
    };
  },
  computed: {
    defaultPeerAvatar() {
      return "";
    },
    peerAvatarFallback() {
      return peerAvatarInitial(this.peerName);
    }
  },
  onLoad(q) {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    this.threadId = q.threadId || "";
    this.peerId = q.peerId || "";
    this.peerName = decodeURIComponent(q.peerName || "聊天");
    this.peerAvatar = decodeURIComponent(q.peerAvatar || "");
    uni.setNavigationBarTitle({ title: this.peerName });
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    load() {
      if (!this.threadId) return;
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/chat/threads/${this.threadId}/messages`).then((d) => {
        this.messages = d.items || [];
        this.scrollToBottom();
      });
    },
    scrollToBottom() {
      const last = this.messages[this.messages.length - 1];
      if (!last) return;
      this.$nextTick(() => {
        this.scrollInto = "m-" + last.id;
      });
    },
    toggleEmoji() {
      this.showEmoji = !this.showEmoji;
    },
    appendEmoji(e) {
      this.draft += e;
    },
    sendText() {
      const text = this.draft.trim();
      if (!text || this.sending) return;
      this.postMessage(text, "text");
    },
    postMessage(content, msgType) {
      this.sending = true;
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/chat/threads/${this.threadId}/messages`, {
        method: "POST",
        data: { content, msgType }
      })
        .then((row) => {
          this.messages.push(row);
          this.draft = "";
          this.showEmoji = false;
          this.scrollToBottom();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发送失败", icon: "none" });
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.sending = false;
        });
    },
    chooseImage() {
      if (this.sending) return;
      uni.chooseImage({
        count: 1,
        sizeType: ["compressed"],
        sourceType: ["album", "camera"],
        success: (res) => {
          const path = res.tempFilePaths && res.tempFilePaths[0];
          if (path) this.uploadImage(path);
        }
      });
    },
    uploadImage(filePath) {
      const token = getToken();
      this.sending = true;
      uni.uploadFile({
        url: `${config.apiBase}/api/adhub/chat/upload-image`,
        filePath,
        name: "file",
        header: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
        success: (res) => {
          if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
            uni.showToast({ title: "图片上传失败", icon: "none" });
            return;
          }
          let data = {};
          try {
            data = JSON.parse(res.data || "{}");
          } catch (err) {
            uni.showToast({ title: "图片上传失败", icon: "none" });
            return;
          }
          if (!data.url) {
            uni.showToast({ title: "图片上传失败", icon: "none" });
            return;
          }
          this.postMessage(`[img]${data.url}`, "image");
        },
        fail: () => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "图片上传失败", icon: "none" });
          this.sending = false;
        }
      });
    },
    previewImage(url) {
      if (!url) return;
      uni.previewImage({ urls: [url], current: url });
    }
  }
};
</script>

content.text:
原因是头像按钮上 **`@tap` 和 `open-type="chooseAvatar"` 叠在一起**，一次点击会触发两次选头像，控制台就会报 `chooseAvatar:fail another chooseAvatar is in progress`，菜单也会延迟弹出。

已改成：
- 去掉 `@tap` 和点击时的动态样式（避免重复触发、减少重绘）
- 只保留微信原生 `chooseAvatar` 按钮
- 取消/重复点击类错误在 `@error` 里静默处理，不再打扰用户

重新编译后再试，**点一次等菜单弹出即可**；开发者工具里偶尔仍会慢 1～2 秒，真机一般更快。若还报错，注意不要连点头像。

[REDACTED]

      </view>

            <text>{{ selectedCampaignName }}</text>
            <text class="picker-arrow">▼</text>
          </view>
        </picker>

        <view v-if="pickedCampaign" class="param-grid">
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">倒计时</text>

          </view>
          <view class="param-row">

          </view>

        <input class="pp-input" v-model="regCompany" placeholder="公司 / 品牌名称" />
