<script>
import { apiRequest, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { getHomeRole, setHomeRole } from "@/common/homeRole.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      role: "publisher",
      loggedIn: false,
      me: null,
      campaignList: [],
      campaignPickIndex: 0,
      linked: [],
      attaching: false,
      adTitle: "",
      adDesc: "",
      adDuration: 30,
      adUnitPrice: "0.15",
      adRewardPoints: "1888",
      publishing: false,
      registering: false,
      regCompany: "",
      myCampaigns: []
    };
  },
  computed: {
    verifyLabel() {
      if (!this.me) return "-";
      return this.me.publisher.verifyStatus === "verified" ? "已认证" : "未认证";
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    },
    repClass() {
      const s = this.me && this.me.publisher.reputationScore;
      return s != null && s < 60 ? "pp-rep pp-rep--low" : "pp-rep";
    },
    campaignNames() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return ["暂无广场广告"];
      return this.campaignList.map((c) => c.title);
    },
    pickedCampaign() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return null;
      return this.campaignList[this.campaignPickIndex] || this.campaignList[0];
    },
    selectedCampaignName() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return "请先到广场查看推广广告";
      return this.pickedCampaign ? this.pickedCampaign.title : "请选择";
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.role = getHomeRole();
    this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
    if (!this.loggedIn) {
      this.me = null;
      return;
    }
    fetchMeCached(true)
      .then((d) => {
        this.me = d;
        this.loadRoleData();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        this.me = null;
      });
  },
  methods: {
    formatPrice(v) {
      return formatYuan(v);
    },
    switchRole(next) {
      this.role = next;
      setHomeRole(next);
      if (this.loggedIn) this.loadRoleData();
    },
    loadRoleData() {
      if (this.role === "publisher") {
        this.loadCampaigns();
        this.loadLinked();
      } else {
        this.loadMyCampaigns();
      }
    },
    loadCampaigns() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/market/campaigns")
        .then((d) => {
          this.campaignList = d.items || [];
          if (this.campaignPickIndex >= this.campaignList.length) {
            this.campaignPickIndex = 0;
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.campaignList = [];
        });
    },
    loadLinked() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns")
        .then((d) => {
          this.linked = d.items || [];
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.linked = [];
        });
    },
    loadMyCampaigns() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.isAdvertiser) {
        this.myCampaigns = [];
        return;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns")
        .then((d) => {
          this.myCampaigns = d.items || [];
        })
        .catch(() => {
          this.myCampaigns = [];
        });
    },
    onCampaignPick(e) {
      this.campaignPickIndex = Number(e.detail.value) || 0;
    },
    attachCampaign() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const c = this.pickedCampaign;
      if (!c) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "暂无可选广告", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.attaching = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: c.id }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "推广设置已保存", icon: "success" });
          this.loadLinked();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          const msg = String(e.detail || "");
          if (msg.includes("实名") || msg.includes("qr")) {
            uni.showModal({
              title: "提示",
              content: "请先完成实名认证并生成专属二维码",
              confirmText: "去认证",
              success: (r) => {
                if (r.confirm) uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" });
              }
            });
          } else {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "保存失败", icon: "none" });
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.attaching = false;
        });
    },
    publishAd() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const title = this.adTitle.trim();
      if (title.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入广告标题", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const unit = parseFloat(this.adUnitPrice);
      if (!Number.isFinite(unit) || unit <= 0) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入有效单价", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const pts = parseInt(this.adRewardPoints, 10);
      if (!Number.isFinite(pts) || pts < 0) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入有效积分", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.publishing = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: {
          title,
          description: this.adDesc.trim(),
          durationSec: this.adDuration,
          unitPriceYuan: unit,
          publisherRewardPoints: pts
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "投放已发布", icon: "success" });
          this.adTitle = "";
          this.adDesc = "";
          clearMeCache();
          fetchMeCached(true).then((d) => {
            this.me = d;
            this.loadMyCampaigns();
          });
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发布失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => {
          this.publishing = false;
        });
    },
    registerAdvertiser() {
      const name = this.regCompany.trim();
      if (name.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入公司/品牌名", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.registering = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/register", {
        method: "POST",
        data: {
          companyName: name,
          contactName: "",
          contactPhone: "",
          contactEmail: "",
          bio: ""
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "入驻成功", icon: "success" });
          clearMeCache();
          return fetchMeCached(true);
        })
        .then((d) => {
          this.me = d;
          this.loadMyCampaigns();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "入驻失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => {
          this.registering = false;
        });
    },
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    goAdvertiserPage() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/advertiser/register" });
    },
    openCampaign(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/campaign-detail?id=${c.id}` });
    },
    openStats(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/advertiser/stats?id=${c.id}` });
    }
  }
};
</script>

content.text:
首页已重写，主要变化如下：

### 顶部身份切换
- **流量主**：推广参数 · 挂载二维码  
- **广告商**：投放参数 · 发布广告  
- 所选身份会记住，下次打开仍保持

### 流量主界面
- 信誉值、实名认证状态  
- **推广参数**：从广场选广告 → 查看倒计时 / 单价 / 积分奖励 → **保存推广设置**（挂载到专属二维码）  
- 已挂载列表、跳转二维码管理

def create_campaign(
    db: Session,
    account: AdHubAccount,
    *,
    title: str,
    description: str = "",
    duration_sec: int = 30,
    valid_duration_sec: int = 25,
    valid_mode: str = "time_ratio",
    valid_browse_sec: int = 0,
    unit_price_fen: int = 15,
    jump_url: str = "",
    media_url: str = "",
    media_type: str = "",
    shake_jump_mode: str = "off",
    publisher_reward_points: int = 0,
) -> AdHubCampaign:
    if not account.is_advertiser or not account.advertiser:
        raise ValueError("not_advertiser")
    title = title.strip()
    if len(title) < 2:
        raise ValueError("title_required")
    duration_sec = max(10, min(120, int(duration_sec)))
    valid_duration_sec = max(1, min(duration_sec, int(valid_duration_sec)))
    valid_browse_sec = max(0, min(300, int(valid_browse_sec)))
    unit_price_fen = max(1, min(999999, int(unit_price_fen)))
    publisher_reward_points = max(0, min(99999, int(publisher_reward_points)))
    allowed_modes = {"time_ratio", "click_jump", "browse_sec", "complete_and_click", "complete_click_browse"}
    if valid_mode not in allowed_modes:
        valid_mode = "time_ratio"
    shake_allowed = {"off", "advertiser", "publisher_apply"}
    if shake_jump_mode not in shake_allowed:
        shake_jump_mode = "off"
    row = AdHubCampaign(
        advertiser_account_id=account.id,
        title=title,
        description=description.strip(),
        duration_sec=duration_sec,
        valid_duration_sec=valid_duration_sec,
        valid_mode=valid_mode,
        valid_browse_sec=valid_browse_sec,
        jump_url=jump_url.strip()[:512],
        media_url=media_url.strip()[:512],
        media_type=(media_type or "").strip()[:16],
        shake_jump_mode=shake_jump_mode,
        unit_price_fen=unit_price_fen,
        publisher_reward_points=publisher_reward_points,
        status="active",
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def _valid_rule_summary(c: AdHubCampaign) -> str:
    total = int(c.duration_sec)
    valid = int(c.valid_duration_sec or max(1, total - 5))
    browse = int(c.valid_browse_sec or 0)
    mode = c.valid_mode or "time_ratio"
    if mode == "click_jump":
        return "点击跳转即有效"
    if mode == "browse_sec":
        return f"跳转后浏览/操作 {browse or 3} 秒有效"
    if mode == "complete_and_click":
        return f"看完 {total} 秒并点击跳转"
    if mode == "complete_click_browse":
        return f"看完 {total} 秒 + 点击 + 浏览 {browse or 3} 秒"
    return f"有效 {valid} 秒 / 总时长 {total} 秒"


def _is_watch_valid(
    campaign: AdHubCampaign | None,
    *,
    duration_sec: int,
    clicked_jump: bool,
    browse_sec: int,
) -> bool:
    if not campaign:
        return duration_sec >= 25
    total = int(campaign.duration_sec)
    valid_min = int(campaign.valid_duration_sec or max(1, total - 5))
    browse_need = int(campaign.valid_browse_sec or 0)
    mode = campaign.valid_mode or "time_ratio"
    if mode == "click_jump":
        return bool(clicked_jump)
    if mode == "browse_sec":
        need = browse_need if browse_need > 0 else 3
        return browse_sec >= need
    if mode == "complete_and_click":
        return duration_sec >= total and clicked_jump
    if mode == "complete_click_browse":
        need = browse_need if browse_need > 0 else 3
        return duration_sec >= total and clicked_jump and browse_sec >= need
    return duration_sec >= valid_min


def _shake_jump_allowed(db: Session, campaign: AdHubCampaign, publisher_id: str) -> bool:
    mode = campaign.shake_jump_mode or "off"
    if mode == "off":
        return False
    if mode == "advertiser":
        return True
    req = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubShakeJumpRequest).where(
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.publisher_account_id == publisher_id,
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.campaign_id == campaign.id,
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.status == "approved",
        )
    )
    return req is not None


def apply_shake_jump(db: Session, publisher_id: str, campaign_id: str, message: str = "") -> AdHubShakeJumpRequest:
    campaign = db.get(AdHubCampaign, campaign_id)
    if not campaign or campaign.status != "active":
        raise ValueError("campaign_not_found")
    if (campaign.shake_jump_mode or "off") != "publisher_apply":
        raise ValueError("shake_not_apply_mode")
    existing = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubShakeJumpRequest).where(
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.publisher_account_id == publisher_id,
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.campaign_id == campaign_id,
        )
    )
    if existing:
        existing.message = message.strip()
        if existing.status == "rejected":
            existing.status = "pending"
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(existing)
        return existing
    row = AdHubShakeJumpRequest(
        publisher_account_id=publisher_id,
        campaign_id=campaign_id,
        message=message.strip(),
        status="pending",
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row


def get_shake_jump_status(db: Session, publisher_id: str, campaign_id: str) -> dict:
    campaign = db.get(AdHubCampaign, campaign_id)
    if not campaign:
        return {"mode": "off", "status": "none", "canApply": False}
    mode = campaign.shake_jump_mode or "off"
    req = db.scalar(
        select(AdHubShakeJumpRequest).where(
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.publisher_account_id == publisher_id,
            AdHubShakeJumpRequest.campaign_id == campaign_id,
        )
    )
    return {
        "mode": mode,
        "status": req.status if req else ("approved" if mode == "advertiser" else "none"),
        "canApply": mode == "publisher_apply" and (not req or req.status == "rejected"),
        "requestId": req.id if req else None,
    }

        <picker :range="campaignNames" :value="campaignPickIndex" @change="onCampaignPick">
          <view class="picker-box">
            <text>{{ selectedCampaignName }}</text>
            <text class="picker-arrow">▼</text>
          </view>
        </picker>

        <view v-if="pickedCampaign" class="param-grid">
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">广告时长</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ pickedCampaign.durationSec }} 秒</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">有效规则</text>
            <text class="param-v param-v--wrap">{{ pickedCampaign.validRuleSummary || formatValidRule(pickedCampaign) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">广告商单价</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ formatPrice(pickedCampaign.unitPriceYuan) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row" v-if="pickedCampaign.shakeJumpMode && pickedCampaign.shakeJumpMode !== 'off'">
            <text class="param-k">摇一摇跳转</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ shakeStatusText }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>

        <button
          v-if="canApplyShake"
          class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost"
          :loading="applyingShake"
          @click="applyShakeJump"
        >申请摇一摇跳转</button>

        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="attaching" @click="attachCampaign">保存推广设置</button>
        <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost" @click="goQr">管理专属二维码</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="linked.length">
        <text class="section-title">当前已挂载</text>
        <view v-for="c in linked" :key="c.id" class="linked-row" @click="openCampaign(c)">
          <text class="linked-title">{{ c.title }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub">{{ c.durationSec }}秒 · {{ formatPrice(c.unitPriceYuan) }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </template>

    <template v-else>
      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="!me.isAdvertiser">
        <text class="section-title">广告商入驻</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="regCompany" placeholder="公司 / 品牌名称" />
        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="registering" @click="registerAdvertiser">快速入驻</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-else>
        <text class="section-title">广告投放参数</text>

        <text class="field-label">广告素材</text>
        <view class="media-row">
          <image v-if="adMediaUrl && adMediaType === 'image'" class="media-preview" :src="adMediaUrl" mode="aspectFill" />
          <text v-else-if="adMediaUrl" class="pp-sub">已上传视频素材</text>
          <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost media-btn" :loading="uploadingMedia" @click="uploadAdMedia">
            {{ adMediaUrl ? "重新上传" : "上传图片/视频" }}
          </button>
        </view>

        <text class="field-label">播放页跳转链接</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adJumpUrl" placeholder="https:// 点击广告后跳转" />

        <text class="field-label">广告标题</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adTitle" maxlength="128" placeholder="2-128 字" />

        <text class="field-label">广告说明</text>
        <textarea class="pp-input textarea" v-model="adDesc" placeholder="投放说明（可选）" />

        <text class="field-label">广告时长（秒）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adDuration" type="number" placeholder="30" />

        <text class="field-label">有效时长（秒）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adValidDuration" type="number" placeholder="25" />

        <text class="field-label">有效规则</text>
        <picker :range="validModeLabels" :value="validModeIndex" @change="onValidModePick">
          <view class="picker-box">
            <text>{{ validModeLabels[validModeIndex] }}</text>
            <text class="picker-arrow">▼</text>
          </view>
        </picker>

        <view v-if="needBrowseSec" class="field-block">
          <text class="field-label">浏览/操作有效秒数</text>
          <input class="pp-input" v-model="adBrowseSec" type="number" placeholder="3" />
        </view>

        <text class="field-label">单价（元 / 次有效推广）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adUnitPrice" type="digit" placeholder="0.15" />

        <text class="field-label">摇一摇跳转</text>
        <picker :range="shakeModeLabels" :value="shakeModeIndex" @change="onShakeModePick">
          <view class="picker-box">
            <text>{{ shakeModeLabels[shakeModeIndex] }}</text>
            <text class="picker-arrow">▼</text>
          </view>
        </picker>

        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="publishing" @click="publishAd">发布投放</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="me.isAdvertiser && myCampaigns.length">
        <text class="section-title">我的投放</text>
        <view v-for="c in myCampaigns" :key="c.id" class="linked-row" @click="openStats(c)">
          <text class="linked-title">{{ c.title }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub">{{ c.validRuleSummary || formatValidRule(c) }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </template>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import config from "@/common/config.js";
import { apiRequest, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { VALID_MODES, SHAKE_MODES, formatValidRule, shakeModeLabel } from "@/common/campaignValid.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { getHomeRole, setHomeRole } from "@/common/homeRole.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      role: "publisher",
      loggedIn: false,
      me: null,
      campaignList: [],
      campaignPickIndex: 0,
      linked: [],
      shakeStatus: null,
      attaching: false,
      applyingShake: false,
      adTitle: "",
      adDesc: "",
      adDuration: "30",
      adValidDuration: "25",
      adBrowseSec: "3",
      validModeIndex: 0,
      shakeModeIndex: 0,
      adUnitPrice: "0.15",
      adJumpUrl: "",
      adMediaUrl: "",
      adMediaType: "",
      uploadingMedia: false,
      publishing: false,
      registering: false,
      regCompany: "",
      myCampaigns: []
    };
  },
  computed: {
    isVerified() {
      return this.me && this.me.publisher && this.me.publisher.verifyStatus === "verified";
    },
    verifyLabel() {
      return this.isVerified ? "已认证" : "未认证";
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    },
    repClass() {
      const s = this.me && this.me.publisher.reputationScore;
      return s != null && s < 60 ? "pp-rep pp-rep--low" : "pp-rep";
    },
    validModeLabels() {
      return VALID_MODES.map((m) => m.label);
    },
    shakeModeLabels() {
      return SHAKE_MODES.map((m) => m.label);
    },
    needBrowseSec() {
      const mode = VALID_MODES[this.validModeIndex]?.value;
      return mode === "browse_sec" || mode === "complete_click_browse";
    },
    campaignNames() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return ["暂无广场广告"];
      return this.campaignList.map((c) => c.title);
    },
    pickedCampaign() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return null;
      return this.campaignList[this.campaignPickIndex] || this.campaignList[0];
    },
    selectedCampaignName() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return "请先到广场查看推广广告";
      return this.pickedCampaign ? this.pickedCampaign.title : "请选择";
    },
    canApplyShake() {
      return this.pickedCampaign && this.pickedCampaign.shakeJumpMode === "publisher_apply" && this.shakeStatus && this.shakeStatus.canApply;
    },
    shakeStatusText() {
      if (!this.pickedCampaign) return "-";
      const mode = this.pickedCampaign.shakeJumpMode;
      if (mode === "advertiser") return "广告商已开启";
      if (mode === "publisher_apply") {
        const st = (this.shakeStatus && this.shakeStatus.status) || "none";
        if (st === "approved") return "已批准";
        if (st === "pending") return "申请审核中";
        if (st === "rejected") return "已拒绝，可重新申请";
        return "需申请启用";
      }
      return shakeModeLabel(mode);
    }
  },
  watch: {
    pickedCampaign() {
      this.loadShakeStatus();
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.role = getHomeRole();
    this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
    if (!this.loggedIn) {
      this.me = null;
      return;
    }
    fetchMeCached(true).then((d) => {
      this.me = d;
      this.loadRoleData();
    }).catch(() => { this.me = null; });
  },
  methods: {
    formatValidRule,
    formatPrice(v) {
      return formatYuan(v);
    },
    switchRole(next) {
      this.role = next;
      setHomeRole(next);
      if (this.loggedIn) this.loadRoleData();
    },
    loadRoleData() {
      if (this.role === "publisher") {
        this.loadCampaigns();
        this.loadLinked();
      } else {
        this.loadMyCampaigns();
      }
    },
    loadCampaigns() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/market/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.campaignList = d.items || [];
        if (this.campaignPickIndex >= this.campaignList.length) this.campaignPickIndex = 0;
        this.loadShakeStatus();
      }).catch(() => { this.campaignList = []; });
    },
    loadLinked() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.linked = d.items || [];
      }).catch(() => { this.linked = []; });
    },
    loadShakeStatus() {
      const c = this.pickedCampaign;
      if (!c || c.shakeJumpMode === "off") {
        this.shakeStatus = null;
        return;
      }
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/me/shake-jump/status?campaignId=${c.id}`).then((d) => {
        this.shakeStatus = d;
      }).catch(() => { this.shakeStatus = null; });
    },
    loadMyCampaigns() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.isAdvertiser) {
        this.myCampaigns = [];
        return;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.myCampaigns = d.items || [];
      }).catch(() => { this.myCampaigns = []; });
    },
    onCampaignPick(e) {
      this.campaignPickIndex = Number(e.detail.value) || 0;
    },
    onValidModePick(e) {
      this.validModeIndex = Number(e.detail.value) || 0;
    },
    onShakeModePick(e) {
      this.shakeModeIndex = Number(e.detail.value) || 0;
    },
    attachCampaign() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const c = this.pickedCampaign;
      if (!c) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "暂无可选广告", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.attaching = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", { method: "POST", data: { campaignId: c.id } })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "推广设置已保存", icon: "success" });
          this.loadLinked();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          const msg = String(e.detail || "");
          if (msg.includes("实名") || msg.includes("qr")) {
            uni.showModal({
              title: "提示",
              content: "请先完成实名认证并生成专属二维码",
              confirmText: "去认证",
              success: (r) => { if (r.confirm) uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" }); }
            });
          } else {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "保存失败", icon: "none" });
          }
        })
        .finally(() => { this.attaching = false; });
    },
    applyShakeJump() {
      if (!this.pickedCampaign) return;
      this.applyingShake = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/shake-jump/apply", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: this.pickedCampaign.id, message: "申请启用摇一摇跳转" }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "已提交申请", icon: "success" });
          this.loadShakeStatus();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "申请失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.applyingShake = false; });
    },
    uploadAdMedia() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.chooseMedia({
        count: 1,
        mediaType: ["image", "video"],
        sourceType: ["album", "camera"],
        success: (res) => {
          const file = res.tempFiles && res.tempFiles[0];
          if (!file) return;
          this.uploadingMedia = true;
          uni.uploadFile({
            url: `${config.apiBase}/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns/upload-media`,
            filePath: file.tempFilePath,
            name: "file",
            header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` },
            success: (up) => {
              if (up.statusCode < 200 || up.statusCode >= 300) {
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" });
                return;
              }
              try {
                const data = JSON.parse(up.data || "{}");
                this.adMediaUrl = data.url || "";
                this.adMediaType = data.mediaType || "image";
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传成功", icon: "success" });
              } catch (err) {
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" });
              }
            },
            fail: () => uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" }),
            complete: () => { this.uploadingMedia = false; }
          });
        }
      });
    },
    publishAd() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const title = this.adTitle.trim();
      if (title.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入广告标题", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const duration = parseInt(this.adDuration, 10);
      const validDur = parseInt(this.adValidDuration, 10);
      const unit = parseFloat(this.adUnitPrice);
      const browse = parseInt(this.adBrowseSec, 10) || 0;
      if (!Number.isFinite(duration) || duration < 10) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "广告时长至少 10 秒", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(unit) || unit <= 0) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入有效单价", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.publishing = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: {
          title,
          description: this.adDesc.trim(),
          durationSec: duration,
          validDurationSec: Number.isFinite(validDur) ? validDur : Math.max(1, duration - 5),
          validMode: VALID_MODES[this.validModeIndex].value,
          validBrowseSec: browse,
          unitPriceYuan: unit,
          jumpUrl: this.adJumpUrl.trim(),
          mediaUrl: this.adMediaUrl,
          mediaType: this.adMediaType,
          shakeJumpMode: SHAKE_MODES[this.shakeModeIndex].value,
          publisherRewardPoints: 0
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "投放已发布", icon: "success" });
          this.adTitle = "";
          this.adDesc = "";
          this.loadMyCampaigns();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发布失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.publishing = false; });
    },
    registerAdvertiser() {
      const name = this.regCompany.trim();
      if (name.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入公司/品牌名", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.registering = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/register", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { companyName: name, contactName: "", contactPhone: "", contactEmail: "", bio: "" }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "入驻成功", icon: "success" });
          clearMeCache();
          return fetchMeCached(true);
        })
        .then((d) => { this.me = d; })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "入驻失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.registering = false; });
    },
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    openCampaign(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/campaign-detail?id=${c.id}` });
    },
    openStats(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/advertiser/stats?id=${c.id}` });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <view class="home-page">
    <view class="role-switch">
      <view :class="['role-item', role === 'publisher' ? 'role-item--active' : '']" @click="switchRole('publisher')">
        <text class="role-name">流量主</text>
        <text class="role-desc">推广参数 · 挂载二维码</text>
      </view>
      <view :class="['role-item', role === 'advertiser' ? 'role-item--active' : '']" @click="switchRole('advertiser')">
        <text class="role-name">广告商</text>
        <text class="role-desc">投放参数 · 发布广告</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view v-if="!loggedIn" class="pp-card block">
      <text class="pp-sub">登录后配置推广或投放参数</text>
      <button class="pp-btn" @click="goLogin">微信一键登录</button>
    </view>

    <template v-else-if="role === 'publisher'">
      <view class="pp-card block">
        <view class="pp-row">
          <text class="pp-label">信誉值</text>
          <text :class="repClass">{{ repText }}</text>
        </view>
        <view class="pp-row">
          <text class="pp-label">实名认证</text>
          <text class="pp-tag" :class="{ 'pp-tag--ok': isVerified }">{{ verifyLabel }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block">
        <text class="section-title">推广参数</text>
        <text class="field-label">挂载推广广告</text>
        <picker :range="campaignNames" :value="campaignPickIndex" @change="onCampaignPick">
          <view class="picker-box">
            <text>{{ selectedCampaignName }}</text>
            <text class="picker-arrow">▼</text>
          </view>
        </picker>

        <view v-if="pickedCampaign" class="param-grid">
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">广告时长</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ pickedCampaign.durationSec }} 秒</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">有效规则</text>
            <text class="param-v param-v--wrap">{{ pickedCampaign.validRuleSummary || formatValidRule(pickedCampaign) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row">
            <text class="param-k">广告商单价</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ formatPrice(pickedCampaign.unitPriceYuan) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="param-row" v-if="pickedCampaign.shakeJumpEnabled">
            <text class="param-k">摇一摇跳转</text>
            <text class="param-v">{{ shakeStatusText }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>

        <text v-if="pickedCampaign && pickedCampaign.shakeJumpEnabled" class="pp-sub shake-hint">
          可在广告详情页申请开启或关闭摇一摇模式
        </text>

        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="attaching" @click="attachCampaign">保存推广设置</button>
        <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost" @click="goQr">管理专属二维码</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="linked.length">
        <text class="section-title">当前已挂载</text>
        <view v-for="c in linked" :key="c.id" class="linked-row" @click="openCampaign(c)">
          <text class="linked-title">{{ c.title }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub">{{ c.durationSec }}秒 · {{ formatPrice(c.unitPriceYuan) }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </template>

    <template v-else>
      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="me && !me.isAdvertiser">
        <text class="section-title">广告商入驻</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="regCompany" placeholder="公司 / 品牌名称" />
        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="registering" @click="registerAdvertiser">快速入驻</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="me && me.isAdvertiser && pendingShakeRequests.length">
        <text class="section-title">摇一摇授权消息</text>
        <view v-for="r in pendingShakeRequests" :key="r.id" class="auth-row">
          <text class="auth-title">{{ r.publisherNickname || "流量主" }} · {{ r.action === "disable" ? "申请关闭" : "申请开启" }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub block">{{ r.campaignTitle }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub block">{{ r.message || "无留言" }}</text>
          <view class="auth-actions">
            <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost auth-btn" :loading="resolvingId === r.id" @click="resolveShake(r, false)">拒绝</button>
            <button class="pp-btn auth-btn" :loading="resolvingId === r.id" @click="resolveShake(r, true)">同意</button>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="me && me.isAdvertiser">
        <text class="section-title">广告投放参数</text>

        <text class="field-label">广告素材</text>
        <view class="media-row">
          <image v-if="adMediaUrl && adMediaType === 'image'" class="media-preview" :src="adMediaUrl" mode="aspectFill" />
          <text v-else-if="adMediaUrl" class="pp-sub">已上传视频素材</text>
          <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost media-btn" :loading="uploadingMedia" @click="uploadAdMedia">
            {{ adMediaUrl ? "重新上传" : "上传图片/视频" }}
          </button>
        </view>

        <text class="field-label">播放页跳转链接</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adJumpUrl" placeholder="https:// 点击广告后跳转" />

        <text class="field-label">广告标题</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adTitle" maxlength="128" placeholder="2-128 字" />

        <text class="field-label">广告说明</text>
        <textarea class="pp-input textarea" v-model="adDesc" placeholder="投放说明（可选）" />

        <text class="field-label">广告时长（秒）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adDuration" type="number" placeholder="30" />

        <text class="field-label">有效时长（秒）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adValidDuration" type="number" placeholder="25" />

        <text class="field-label">有效规则（可多选，全部满足才算有效）</text>
        <view class="tag-row">
          <view
            v-for="tag in validRuleTags"
            :key="tag.value"
            :class="['rule-tag', selectedValidRules.includes(tag.value) ? 'rule-tag--on' : '']"
            @click="toggleValidRule(tag.value)"
          >{{ tag.label }}</view>
        </view>

        <view v-if="needBrowseSec" class="field-block">
          <text class="field-label">浏览/操作有效秒数</text>
          <input class="pp-input" v-model="adBrowseSec" type="number" placeholder="3" />
        </view>

        <text class="field-label">单价（元 / 次有效推广）</text>
        <input class="pp-input" v-model="adUnitPrice" type="digit" placeholder="0.15" />

        <view class="switch-row">
          <text class="field-label switch-label">摇一摇跳转</text>
          <switch :checked="shakeJumpEnabled" color="#111111" @change="onShakeSwitch" />
        </view>
        <text class="pp-sub">开启后，流量主可在广告详情页申请授权；您将收到授权消息</text>

        <button class="pp-btn" :loading="publishing" @click="publishAd">发布投放</button>
      </view>

      <view class="pp-card block" v-if="me && me.isAdvertiser && myCampaigns.length">
        <text class="section-title">我的投放</text>
        <view v-for="c in myCampaigns" :key="c.id" class="linked-row" @click="openStats(c)">
          <text class="linked-title">{{ c.title }}</text>
          <text class="pp-sub">{{ c.validRuleSummary || formatValidRule(c) }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </template>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import config from "@/common/config.js";
import { apiRequest, getToken, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { VALID_RULE_TAGS, formatValidRule, toggleRuleInList } from "@/common/campaignValid.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { getHomeRole, setHomeRole } from "@/common/homeRole.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      role: "publisher",
      loggedIn: false,
      me: null,
      campaignList: [],
      campaignPickIndex: 0,
      linked: [],
      shakeStatus: null,
      attaching: false,
      adTitle: "",
      adDesc: "",
      adDuration: "30",
      adValidDuration: "25",
      adBrowseSec: "3",
      selectedValidRules: ["watch_time"],
      shakeJumpEnabled: false,
      adUnitPrice: "0.15",
      adJumpUrl: "",
      adMediaUrl: "",
      adMediaType: "",
      uploadingMedia: false,
      publishing: false,
      registering: false,
      regCompany: "",
      myCampaigns: [],
      shakeRequests: [],
      resolvingId: ""
    };
  },
  computed: {
    validRuleTags() {
      return VALID_RULE_TAGS;
    },
    isVerified() {
      return this.me && this.me.publisher && this.me.publisher.verifyStatus === "verified";
    },
    verifyLabel() {
      return this.isVerified ? "已认证" : "未认证";
    },
    repText() {
      if (!this.me) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.me.publisher.reputationScore);
    },
    repClass() {
      const s = this.me && this.me.publisher.reputationScore;
      return s != null && s < 60 ? "pp-rep pp-rep--low" : "pp-rep";
    },
    needBrowseSec() {
      return this.selectedValidRules.includes("browse_sec");
    },
    campaignNames() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return ["暂无广场广告"];
      return this.campaignList.map((c) => c.title);
    },
    pickedCampaign() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return null;
      return this.campaignList[this.campaignPickIndex] || this.campaignList[0];
    },
    selectedCampaignName() {
      if (!this.campaignList.length) return "请先到广场查看推广广告";
      return this.pickedCampaign ? this.pickedCampaign.title : "请选择";
    },
    shakeStatusText() {
      if (!this.pickedCampaign || !this.pickedCampaign.shakeJumpEnabled) return "未开启";
      const st = this.shakeStatus || {};
      if (st.shakeActive) return "已授权开启";
      if (st.status === "pending") {
        return st.pendingAction === "disable" ? "关闭申请审核中" : "开启申请审核中";
      }
      if (st.status === "rejected") return "授权已拒绝";
      return "未授权，请到广告详情申请";
    },
    pendingShakeRequests() {
      return (this.shakeRequests || []).filter((r) => r.status === "pending");
    }
  },
  watch: {
    pickedCampaign() {
      this.loadShakeStatus();
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.role = getHomeRole();
    this.loggedIn = !!getToken();
    if (!this.loggedIn) {
      this.me = null;
      return;
    }
    fetchMeCached(true).then((d) => {
      this.me = d;
      this.loadRoleData();
    }).catch(() => { this.me = null; });
  },
  methods: {
    formatValidRule,
    formatPrice(v) {
      return formatYuan(v);
    },
    switchRole(next) {
      this.role = next;
      setHomeRole(next);
      if (this.loggedIn) this.loadRoleData();
    },
    loadRoleData() {
      if (this.role === "publisher") {
        this.loadCampaigns();
        this.loadLinked();
      } else {
        this.loadMyCampaigns();
        this.loadShakeRequests();
      }
    },
    loadCampaigns() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/market/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.campaignList = d.items || [];
        if (this.campaignPickIndex >= this.campaignList.length) this.campaignPickIndex = 0;
        this.loadShakeStatus();
      }).catch(() => { this.campaignList = []; });
    },
    loadLinked() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.linked = d.items || [];
      }).catch(() => { this.linked = []; });
    },
    loadShakeStatus() {
      const c = this.pickedCampaign;
      if (!c || !c.shakeJumpEnabled) {
        this.shakeStatus = null;
        return;
      }
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/me/shake-jump/status?campaignId=${c.id}`).then((d) => {
        this.shakeStatus = d;
      }).catch(() => { this.shakeStatus = null; });
    },
    loadShakeRequests() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.isAdvertiser) {
        this.shakeRequests = [];
        return;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/shake-jump/requests").then((d) => {
        this.shakeRequests = d.items || [];
      }).catch(() => { this.shakeRequests = []; });
    },
    loadMyCampaigns() {
      if (!this.me || !this.me.isAdvertiser) {
        this.myCampaigns = [];
        return;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns").then((d) => {
        this.myCampaigns = d.items || [];
      }).catch(() => { this.myCampaigns = []; });
    },
    onCampaignPick(e) {
      this.campaignPickIndex = Number(e.detail.value) || 0;
    },
    toggleValidRule(value) {
      this.selectedValidRules = toggleRuleInList(this.selectedValidRules, value);
    },
    onShakeSwitch(e) {
      this.shakeJumpEnabled = !!e.detail.value;
    },
    resolveShake(row, approve) {
      this.resolvingId = row.id;
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/advertiser/shake-jump/requests/${row.id}/resolve`, {
        method: "POST",
        data: { approve }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: approve ? "已同意" : "已拒绝", icon: "success" });
          this.loadShakeRequests();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "操作失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.resolvingId = ""; });
    },
    attachCampaign() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const c = this.pickedCampaign;
      if (!c) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "暂无可选广告", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.attaching = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", { method: "POST", data: { campaignId: c.id } })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "推广设置已保存", icon: "success" });
          this.loadLinked();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          const msg = String(e.detail || "");
          if (msg.includes("实名") || msg.includes("qr")) {
            uni.showModal({
              title: "提示",
              content: "请先完成实名认证并生成专属二维码",
              confirmText: "去认证",
              success: (r) => { if (r.confirm) uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/verify/index" }); }
            });
          } else {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "保存失败", icon: "none" });
          }
        })
        .finally(() => { this.attaching = false; });
    },
    uploadAdMedia() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.chooseMedia({
        count: 1,
        mediaType: ["image", "video"],
        sourceType: ["album", "camera"],
        success: (res) => {
          const file = res.tempFiles && res.tempFiles[0];
          if (!file) return;
          this.uploadingMedia = true;
          uni.uploadFile({
            url: `${config.apiBase}/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns/upload-media`,
            filePath: file.tempFilePath,
            name: "file",
            header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` },
            success: (up) => {
              if (up.statusCode < 200 || up.statusCode >= 300) {
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" });
                return;
              }
              try {
                const data = JSON.parse(up.data || "{}");
                this.adMediaUrl = data.url || "";
                this.adMediaType = data.mediaType || "image";
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传成功", icon: "success" });
              } catch (err) {
                uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" });
              }
            },
            fail: () => uni.showToast({ title: "上传失败", icon: "none" }),
            complete: () => { this.uploadingMedia = false; }
          });
        }
      });
    },
    publishAd() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      const title = this.adTitle.trim();
      if (title.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入广告标题", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const duration = parseInt(this.adDuration, 10);
      const validDur = parseInt(this.adValidDuration, 10);
      const unit = parseFloat(this.adUnitPrice);
      const browse = parseInt(this.adBrowseSec, 10) || 0;
      if (!Number.isFinite(duration) || duration < 10) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "广告时长至少 10 秒", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(unit) || unit <= 0) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入有效单价", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const validRules = (this.selectedValidRules || ["watch_time"]).join(",");
      this.publishing = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: {
          title,
          description: this.adDesc.trim(),
          durationSec: duration,
          validDurationSec: Number.isFinite(validDur) ? validDur : Math.max(1, duration - 5),
          validRules,
          validBrowseSec: browse,
          unitPriceYuan: unit,
          jumpUrl: this.adJumpUrl.trim(),
          mediaUrl: this.adMediaUrl,
          mediaType: this.adMediaType,
          shakeJumpEnabled: this.shakeJumpEnabled,
          publisherRewardPoints: 0
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "投放已发布", icon: "success" });
          this.adTitle = "";
          this.adDesc = "";
          this.loadMyCampaigns();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "发布失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.publishing = false; });
    },
    registerAdvertiser() {
      const name = this.regCompany.trim();
      if (name.length < 2) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "请输入公司/品牌名", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.registering = true;
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/advertiser/register", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { companyName: name, contactName: "", contactPhone: "", contactEmail: "", bio: "" }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "入驻成功", icon: "success" });
          clearMeCache();
          return fetchMeCached(true);
        })
        .then((d) => { this.me = d; this.loadRoleData(); })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "入驻失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.registering = false; });
    },
    goLogin() {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/auth/login" });
    },
    goQr() {
      if (!requireLogin()) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: "/pages/qr/index" });
    },
    openCampaign(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/campaign-detail?id=${c.id}` });
    },
    openStats(c) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/advertiser/stats?id=${c.id}` });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <view class="pp-page">
    <view class="pp-card" v-if="detail">
      <text class="pp-title">{{ detail.title }}</text>
      <text class="pp-tag block">{{ detail.durationSec }} 秒广告</text>

      <text class="pp-sub block">{{ detail.description || "暂无说明" }}</text>
    </view>

    <view class="pp-card" v-if="advertiser">
      <text class="pp-title">广告商</text>
      <text class="pp-label block">{{ advertiser.companyName || advertiser.nickname }}</text>
      <text :class="advertiser.reputationScore < 60 ? 'pp-rep pp-rep--low' : 'pp-rep'">信誉 {{ advRep }}</text>
      <text class="pp-sub block">{{ advertiser.bio || "暂无简介" }}</text>
      <view class="contact-block">
        <text v-if="advertiser.contactPhone" class="contact-line" @click="callPhone(advertiser.contactPhone)">电话：{{ advertiser.contactPhone }}</text>

      </view>
      <button class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost" @click="openAdvertiser">查看广告商主页</button>
    </view>

    <view class="pp-card" v-if="detail && detail.shakeJumpEnabled && !isOwner">
      <text class="pp-title">摇一摇跳转</text>
      <text class="pp-sub block">{{ shakeHint }}</text>
      <button
        v-if="canApplyEnable"
        class="pp-btn"
        :loading="applying"
        @click="applyShake('enable')"
      >申请开启摇一摇</button>
      <button
        v-if="canApplyDisable"
        class="pp-btn pp-btn--ghost"
        :loading="applying"
        @click="applyShake('disable')"
      >申请关闭摇一摇</button>
    </view>

    <button v-if="detail && !isOwner" class="pp-btn" @click="attach">加单到我的二维码</button>

    <view class="pp-card" v-if="loading"><text class="pp-sub">加载中…</text></view>
    <view class="pp-card" v-if="err"><text class="pp-sub">{{ err }}</text></view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatValidRule } from "@/common/campaignValid.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      id: "",
      detail: null,
      advertiser: null,
      me: null,
      shakeStatus: null,
      applying: false,
      loading: true,
      err: ""
    };
  },
  computed: {
    priceText() {
      if (!this.detail) return "¥0.00";
      return formatYuan(this.detail.unitPriceYuan);
    },
    ruleText() {
      if (!this.detail) return "-";
      return this.detail.validRuleSummary || formatValidRule(this.detail);
    },
    advRep() {
      if (!this.advertiser) return "100/100";
      return formatReputation(this.advertiser.reputationScore);
    },
    isOwner() {
      return this.me && this.detail && this.me.id === this.detail.advertiserId;
    },
    canApplyEnable() {
      return this.shakeStatus && this.shakeStatus.canApplyEnable;
    },
    canApplyDisable() {
      return this.shakeStatus && this.shakeStatus.canApplyDisable;
    },
    shakeHint() {
      if (!this.shakeStatus) return "加载中…";
      if (this.shakeStatus.shakeActive) return "您已获授权，观众扫码观看时可使用摇一摇跳转。";
      if (this.shakeStatus.status === "pending") {
        return this.shakeStatus.pendingAction === "disable"
          ? "关闭摇一摇的申请已提交，等待广告商授权。"
          : "开启摇一摇的申请已提交，等待广告商授权。";
      }
      if (this.shakeStatus.status === "rejected") return "上次申请被拒绝，可重新申请开启。";
      return "广告商已开启摇一摇功能，您可向广告商申请授权后启用。";
    }
  },
  onLoad(q) {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    this.id = q.id || "";
    fetchMeCached().then((d) => { this.me = d; });
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    load() {
      this.loading = true;
      this.err = "";
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/market/campaigns/${encodeURIComponent(this.id)}`)
        .then((d) => {
          this.detail = d;
          this.advertiser = d.advertiser || null;
          this.loadShakeStatus();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.err = e.detail || "加载失败";
          this.detail = null;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.loading = false;
        });
    },
    loadShakeStatus() {
      if (!this.detail || !this.detail.shakeJumpEnabled) {
        this.shakeStatus = null;
        return;
      }
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/me/shake-jump/status?campaignId=${this.id}`)
        .then((d) => { this.shakeStatus = d; })
        .catch(() => { this.shakeStatus = null; });
    },
    applyShake(action) {
      this.applying = true;
      const msg = action === "disable" ? "申请关闭摇一摇跳转" : "申请开启摇一摇跳转";
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/shake-jump/apply", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: this.id, action, message: msg }
      })
        .then(() => {
          uni.showToast({ title: "已提交申请", icon: "success" });
          this.loadShakeStatus();
        })
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "申请失败", icon: "none" }))
        .finally(() => { this.applying = false; });
    },
    attach() {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: this.id }
      })
        .then(() => uni.showToast({ title: "已加单", icon: "success" }))
        .catch((e) => uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "失败", icon: "none" }));
    },
    openAdvertiser() {
      if (!this.advertiser) return;
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/detail?id=${this.advertiser.id}&role=advertiser` });
    },
    callPhone(phone) {
      uni.makePhoneCall({ phoneNumber: phone });
    },
    copyText(text) {
      uni.setClipboardData({ data: text, success: () => uni.showToast({ title: "已复制", icon: "success" }) });
    }
  }
};
</script>

说明 uniCloud 与本地后端的区别，并更新配置以支持真机调试。

[REDACTED]

## 「关联服务空间」是什么？

这是 **uniCloud（DCloud 云开发）** 的配置，用来把项目绑到阿里云/腾讯云上的 **uniCloud 服务空间**（云函数、云数据库、uni-id 登录等）。

你的 **扫码看广业务 API** 在本地：

`论文润色/扫码看广/server` → `http://127.0.0.1:8001`

业务请求走的是 `common/config.js` 里的 `apiBase`，**和关联 uniCloud 无关**。弹窗里选 `once` 阿里云，只影响插件里的 `uniCloud.xxx()`，**不会**让小程序连上你电脑上的 8001 服务。

---

## 真机为什么连不上？

模拟器里的 `127.0.0.1` 指向 **电脑**；真机上 `127.0.0.1` 指向 **手机自己**，所以访问不到你电脑上的后端。

---

## 真机调试怎么做？

1. **改 API 地址**（已在 `common/config.js` 写好开关）：
   - 模拟器：`USE_SIMULATOR = true`（127.0.0.1）
   - 真机：`USE_SIMULATOR = false`，使用 `LAN_API`（已填你电脑的 `10.20.92.59`，不对就改成 `ipconfig` 里 WiFi 那个 IPv4）

2. **后端要监听局域网**（不能只绑 127.0.0.1）：
   ```bash
   cd 论文润色/扫码看广/server
   python -m uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
   ```

3. **手机与电脑同一 WiFi**，Windows 防火墙放行 **8001** 端口。

4. 微信里用 **真机调试**（不是普通预览），手机上打开 **调试模式**，开发阶段才能访问未配置的 http 域名。

5. 手机浏览器访问 `http://10.20.92.59:8001/api/health`，应返回 `{"status":"ok"}`；不通就先查 IP、防火墙和服务是否 `--host 0.0.0.0`。

---

**总结**：关联服务空间 → uniCloud 云后端；扫码看广登录/投放 → 本地 8001。真机要把 `127.0.0.1` 换成电脑局域网 IP，并让服务监听 `0.0.0.0`。需要的话我可以帮你用 `0.0.0.0` 重启 8001 服务。

<user_query>
这个必须在局域网内试调吗
</user_query>

不完全是「必须在局域网内」，取决于你怎么调试：

### 微信开发者工具模拟器
不需要局域网。后端跑在本机，用 `USE_SIMULATOR = true` + `127.0.0.1:8001` 即可。

### 手机真机调试（后端还在你电脑上）
手机访问不到电脑的 `127.0.0.1`，必须能连到运行后端的机器。最常见做法是：

- 手机和电脑 **同一 WiFi / 同一局域网**
- `config.js` 里 `USE_SIMULATOR = false`，填电脑局域网 IP（你现在是 `10.20.92.59`）
- 后端用 `--host 0.0.0.0` 监听

这不是微信强制「必须局域网」，而是 **真机 + 本地后端** 时，局域网是最省事的方式。

### 不在同一局域网也可以
把后端放到手机能访问的地址即可，例如：

| 方式 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 云服务器 | 把 `server` 部署到公网，API 改成 `https://你的域名` |
| 内网穿透 | ngrok、cpolar、frp 等，得到公网 URL 填进 `apiBase` |
| 仅模拟器 | 不真机测，一直用开发者工具 |

### 上线后
微信小程序正式环境要求 **HTTPS + 在微信后台配置合法域名**，不能长期用 `http://192.168.x.x` 这种内网地址。

---

**结论**：模拟器不必局域网；真机测本地 8001 时，同一 WiFi 最方便。若不在同一网络，需要云部署或内网穿透，并把 `apiBase` 改成对应公网地址。

[REDACTED]

<user_query>
要跳转的软件链接怎么获取
</user_query>

「播放页跳转链接」不是系统自动生成的，需要**广告商自己准备**：观众在 H5 观看页点击「点击跳转」或完成摇一摇后，会打开这个地址。

## 这个链接是什么？

就是你要推广的**落地页 URL**，填在首页「广告投放参数 → 播放页跳转链接」里，保存到后端的 `jumpUrl` 字段。

当前观看页会用浏览器打开它，例如：

- 官网：`https://www.example.com/promo`
- 商品页：`https://item.taobao.com/...`
- 活动页：`https://your-site.com/activity`
- 公众号文章：`https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/...`（需可公网访问）

发布时会校验：**必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头**。

---

## 链接从哪来？

| 推广目标 | 常见获取方式 |
|---------|-------------|
| 自有网站/活动页 | 在自己服务器或建站工具里做好页面，复制浏览器地址栏 URL |
| 电商商品 | 淘宝/京东/拼多多等商品页「复制链接」 |
| 公众号/视频号 | 文章或主页的 HTTPS 链接 |
| App 下载 | App Store / 应用宝 / 官网下载页的 **https** 链接 |
| 小程序 | 当前实现是 **H5 外链**，不能直接填 `pages/xxx`；要用「URL Link / 短链 / 中间 H5 页再跳小程序」 |

系统**不会**帮你生成推广链接，除非你们自己再做「短链/追踪链接」功能。

---

## 开发调试怎么填？

- 本地测：可先填 `https://www.baidu.com` 或任意可访问的 https 页面（真机要能访问该域名）。
- 不要用 `127.0.0.1`：观众手机打不开你电脑上的地址。

---

## 和「扫码看广」本身的关系

- **挂载/观看**：走你的二维码 + `server` 的 H5 页（`/static/adhub-watch/`）
- **跳转链接**：广告商想让人**看完广告后去哪里**，由广告商提供

若你希望「填小程序内路径也能跳」或「系统自动生成带统计的短链」，需要单独开发，当前版本只支持普通 **http(s) 网页链接**。

<template>
  <view class="pp-page">
    <view class="pp-card" v-if="session">
      <view v-if="mediaUrl" class="media-wrap">
        <video
          v-if="isVideo"
          :src="mediaUrl"
          class="ad-media"
          controls
          autoplay
          show-center-play-btn
          object-fit="contain"
          :enable-progress-gesture="true"
        />
        <image v-else class="ad-media ad-media--img" :src="mediaUrl" mode="widthFix" />
      </view>
      <text v-else class="pp-sub media-empty">该广告暂未上传素材</text>

      <text class="pp-title">{{ campaignTitle }}</text>
      <text v-if="campaignDesc" class="pp-sub">{{ campaignDesc }}</text>
      <text v-if="validRuleSummary" class="pp-sub rule-line">有效规则：{{ validRuleSummary }}</text>

      <view class="count">{{ left }}</view>
      <text class="pp-sub hint">请保持页面在前台，倒计时结束后记录有效推广</text>
      <text v-if="unitPriceText" class="reward">{{ unitPriceText }}</text>
      <text class="msg" :class="msgClass">{{ msg }}</text>
    </view>
    <view class="pp-card" v-else>
      <text class="pp-sub">{{ err || "加载中…" }}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { apiRequest } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      code: "",
      session: null,
      left: 30,
      msg: "",
      msgClass: "",
      err: "",
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    campaignTitle() {
      if (this.session && this.session.campaign) return this.session.campaign.title;
      return "观看广告";
    },
    campaignDesc() {
      if (this.session && this.session.campaign) return this.session.campaign.description || "";
      return "";
    },
    mediaUrl() {
      if (!this.session) return "";
      return this.session.mediaUrl || (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.mediaUrl) || "";
    },
    mediaType() {
      if (!this.session) return "";
      return this.session.mediaType || (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.mediaType) || "";
    },
    isVideo() {
      return this.mediaType === "video";
    },
    validRuleSummary() {
      if (!this.session) return "";
      return this.session.validRuleSummary || "";
    },
    unitPriceText() {
      if (!this.session || !this.session.campaign) return "";
      const y = this.session.campaign.unitPriceYuan;
      return y ? `有效观看预计收益 ${formatYuan(y)} / 次` : "";
    }
  },
  onLoad(q) {
    this.code = (q.code || "").trim();
    if (!this.code) {
      this.err = "缺少二维码参数";
      return;
    }
    this.loadSession();
  },
  onUnload() {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
  },
  methods: {
    loadSession() {
      apiRequest(`/api/adhub/watch/session?code=${encodeURIComponent(this.code)}`, { auth: false })
        .then((d) => {
          this.session = d;
          this.left = d.durationSec || 30;
          this.startTimer();
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.err = e.detail || "无法加载";
        });
    },
    startTimer() {
      if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
      this.timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (this.left <= 1) {
          clearInterval(this.timer);
          this.left = 0;
          this.finish();
          return;
        }
        this.left -= 1;
      }, 1000);
    },
    finish() {
      this.msg = "正在提交…";
      const duration = this.session.durationSec || 30;
      const body = {
        code: this.code,
        viewerKey: "mp_preview_" + Date.now(),
        durationSec: duration
      };
      if (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.id) {
        body.campaignId = this.session.campaign.id;
      }
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/watch/complete", { method: "POST", auth: false, data: body })
        .then((d) => {
          if (d.suspicious) {
            this.msgClass = "warn";
            this.msg = "已记录，本次标记为可疑观看";
          } else {
            this.msgClass = "ok";
            const y = d.unitPriceYuan != null ? d.unitPriceYuan : (this.session.campaign && this.session.campaign.unitPriceYuan);
            this.msg = y ? `观看完成，收益预览 ${formatYuan(y)}` : "观看完成";
          }
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.msgClass = "err";
          this.msg = e.detail || "提交失败";
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

    <view v-if="tab !== 'campaigns' && !loading && !list.length" class="pp-card"><text class="pp-sub">暂无数据</text></view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { formatAdCategories, formatAudiences } from "@/common/adTags.js";
import { formatReputation, formatYuan } from "@/common/format.js";
import { fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      tab: "publishers",
      list: [],
      campaignList: [],
      minRep: 0,
      me: null,
      loading: false
    };
  },
  onShow() {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    fetchMeCached().then((d) => { this.me = d; }).catch(() => { this.me = null; });
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    formatPrice(v) {
      return formatYuan(v);
    },
    formatRep(score) {
      return formatReputation(score);
    },
    categoryLabels(item) {
      return formatAdCategories(item.adCategories);
    },
    audienceLabels(item) {
      return formatAudiences(item.targetAudiences);
    },
    switchTab(name) {
      if (this.tab === name) return;
      this.tab = name;
      this.load();
    },
    onRepChange(e) {
      this.minRep = e.detail.value;
      this.load();
    },
    load() {
      this.loading = true;
      if (this.tab === "campaigns") {
        apiRequest("/api/adhub/market/campaigns")
          .then((d) => { this.campaignList = d.items || []; })
          .finally(() => { this.loading = false; });
        return;
      }
      const path =
        this.tab === "publishers"
          ? `/api/adhub/market/publishers?minReputation=${this.minRep}`
          : "/api/adhub/market/advertisers";
      apiRequest(path)
        .then((d) => { this.list = d.items || []; })
        .finally(() => { this.loading = false; });
    },
    displayName(item) {
      if (item.companyName) return item.companyName;
      return item.nickname || item.realNameMasked || "用户";
    },
    openDetail(item) {
      const role = item.role || (this.tab === "advertisers" ? "advertiser" : "publisher");
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/detail?id=${item.id}&role=${role}` });
    },
    openCampaignDetail(item) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/market/campaign-detail?id=${item.id}` });
    },
    openStats(item) {
      uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/advertiser/stats?id=${item.id}` });
    },
    attachCampaign(item) {
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/qr/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        data: { campaignId: item.id }
      })
        .then(() => uni.showToast({ title: "已申请接单", icon: "success" }))
        .catch((e) => {
          const msg = String(e.detail || "");
          if (msg.includes("qr_not_ready") || msg.includes("实名")) {
            uni.showModal({ title: "提示", content: "请先完成实名认证并生成专属二维码", showCancel: false });
          } else {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.detail || "申请失败", icon: "none" });
          }
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

<script>
import { AD_CATEGORY_TAGS, AUDIENCE_TAGS, parseTagList, toggleTagInList } from "@/common/adTags.js";
import { apiRequest, requireLogin } from "@/common/api.js";
import { clearMeCache, fetchMeCached } from "@/common/sessionCache.js";

function stripPhonePrefix(phone) {
  return (phone || "").trim().replace(/^\+86/, "");
}

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      phone: "",
      email: "",
      websiteUrl: "",
      bio: "",
      adCategoryTags: AD_CATEGORY_TAGS,
      audienceTags: AUDIENCE_TAGS,
      selectedAdCategories: [],
      selectedAudiences: [],
      saving: false,
      err: ""
    };
  },
  onLoad() {
    if (!requireLogin()) return;
    fetchMeCached(true)
      .then((me) => {
        const pub = me.publisher || {};
        this.phone = stripPhonePrefix(pub.contactPhone);
        this.email = pub.contactEmail || "";
        this.websiteUrl = pub.websiteUrl || "";
        this.bio = pub.bio || "";
        this.selectedAdCategories = parseTagList(pub.adCategories);
        this.selectedAudiences = parseTagList(pub.targetAudiences);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        this.err = "无法加载联系方式";
      });
  },
  methods: {
    onPhoneInput(e) {
      const raw = (e.detail && e.detail.value) || "";
      this.phone = raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 11);
    },
    validatePhone(phone) {
      if (!phone) return true;
      return /^1\d{10}$/.test(phone);
    },
    normalizePhoneForSave(phone) {
      if (!phone) return "";
      return `+86${phone}`;
    },
    toggleAdCategory(value) {
      this.selectedAdCategories = toggleTagInList(this.selectedAdCategories, value);
    },
    toggleAudience(value) {
      this.selectedAudiences = toggleTagInList(this.selectedAudiences, value);
    },
    save() {
      const phone = (this.phone || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
      if (phone && !this.validatePhone(phone)) {
        this.err = "请填写正确的11位中国大陆手机号";
        return;
      }
      this.saving = true;
      this.err = "";
      apiRequest("/api/adhub/me/publisher", {
        method: "PUT",
        data: {
          contactPhone: this.normalizePhoneForSave(phone),
          contactEmail: (this.email || "").trim(),
          websiteUrl: this.websiteUrl,
          bio: this.bio,
          adCategories: this.selectedAdCategories.join(","),
          targetAudiences: this.selectedAudiences.join(",")
        }
      })
        .then(() => {
          clearMeCache();
          uni.showToast({ title: "已保存", icon: "success" });
          setTimeout(() => uni.navigateBack(), 400);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          this.err = e.detail || "保存失败";
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.saving = false;
        });
    }
  }
};
</script>

content.text:
已修复。中文输入法弹出候选窗时，浏览器会对输入框触发 `mouseleave`，有时还会短暂影响焦点判断，导致四角框选被误取消。

**本次改动（`TargetCursor.tsx`）：**

1. **输入框聚焦或正在拼音组合时，保持框选** — 只要输入框有焦点，或正在 `composition`（打拼音），就不响应 `mouseleave` 取消框选。
2. **监听 `compositionstart` / `compositionend`** — 开始打拼音时重新激活并刷新框选位置；结束后再更新一次。
3. **优化 `focusout` 判断** — 焦点若仍在同一输入框内（如 Ant Design 内外层结构），不取消；并用双重 `requestAnimationFrame` 避免 IME 造成的焦点闪烁误判。
4. **修正 `cleanupTarget` 定义顺序** — 避免潜在运行时错误。

已做性能优化，**逐字动画效果保留**，主要减轻卡顿来源：

### 原因
原先每 **18ms** 用 `setInterval` 更新整份 `paragraphs`，所有段落卡片（Ant Design Card 等）都会重渲染，还要每帧跑字数正则——长文时很容易掉帧。

### 优化措施

1. **独立打字预览态**（`typingDisplay`）  
   动画期间只更新正在播放的那一段，其它段落 props 不变。

2. **`requestAnimationFrame` 替代 `setInterval`**  
   按帧批量出字（约 56 字/秒，观感与原来接近），与浏览器刷新同步。

3. **字数统计降频**  
   每 12 个字才重算一次 `wordCount`，结束时再精确一次。

4. **`React.memo` 包裹段落卡片**  
   未在改写的段落跳过渲染。

5. **滚动跟随**  
   实时跟随改为**瞬时定位**（不再 `smooth`），并去重，避免滚动动画和打字抢主线程。

6. **CSS**  
   离屏段落 `content-visibility: auto`；正在打字的卡片 `contain: layout style paint`，缩小重绘范围。

刷新页面后再跑一段降 AIGC，逐字效果应还在，流畅度会明显好一些。若仍觉得偏慢或偏快，可以说一下，我可以帮你调 `TYPING_CHARS_PER_SECOND`（当前 56）。

# 前端运行时轻量化（保留全部动效）

## Impeccable 能借鉴什么、不能照搬什么

[Impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable) **不是**轻量 UI 框架，而是一套 **AI 设计/性能工作流**（`init`、`distill`、`optimize`、`animate`、41 条 detect 规则）。对本项目最有用的是：

| Impeccable 概念 | 映射到 downAiGC |
|---|---|
| **distill**（去冗余） | 减少「全局必加载」的重依赖；动效保留，但改为 **按需挂载** |
| **optimize**（性能） | 路由拆包、vendor 分包、离屏段落跳过布局（已有 `content-visibility`） |
| **animate**（有目的的动效） | 只用 `transform`/`opacity` 做入场；避免 `smooth scroll` 与逐字 rAF 抢主线程（工作台已部分修复） |
| **detect CLI** | 可选：`npx impeccable detect frontend/src` 做回归扫描（bounce easing、touch target 等） |

**不建议**在本阶段引入 Impeccable 全套 skill 文档（`PRODUCT.md`/`DESIGN.md`）作为首要任务——你当前目标是 **运行时**，不是 redesign。

---

## 现状诊断（为何「整体文件」感觉重）

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  mainTsx[main.tsx 同步入口]
  mainTsx --> antdReset[antd reset + zhCN]
  mainTsx --> stylesCss["styles.css ~101KB"]
  mainTsx --> shader[AppShaderBackdrop]
  mainTsx --> cursor[TargetCursor + gsap]
  mainTsx --> appRoutes[App.tsx 全量页面]
  shader --> three[three.js ~600KB级]
  cursor --> gsapLib[gsap]
  appRoutes --> workbench[PolishWorkbenchPage 长文 DOM]
```

关键文件：

- [`frontend/src/main.tsx`](frontend/src/main.tsx)：**同步**挂载 `AppShaderBackdrop`、`TargetCursor`、全站 `styles.css`
- [`frontend/src/App.tsx`](frontend/src/App.tsx)：**无** `React.lazy`，20+ 页面一次性进主包
- [`frontend/src/styles.css`](frontend/src/styles.css)：3357 行 / ~101KB，含 galaxy/stagger/login 等大量动画规则
- [`frontend/vite.config.ts`](frontend/vite.config.ts)：无 `manualChunks`、无 bundle 分析
- 工作台逐字：已在 [`PolishWorkbenchPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/PolishWorkbenchPage.tsx) 用 `typingDisplay` + rAF 优化；[`ParagraphCompareCard.tsx`](frontend/src/components/ParagraphCompareCard.tsx) 仍用 Ant Design `Card/Row/Col`（长文时 DOM 仍偏重）

---

## 目标

- **保留**：逐字输出、Three 极光、TargetCursor、Galaxy 按钮、stagger 入场
- **优化**：首屏 JS/CSS 下载量、主线程占用、长文工作台帧率

## 实施计划（分 4 步，按收益排序）

### 1. 路由与重依赖按需加载（最大 bundle 收益）

**改动 [`frontend/src/App.tsx`](frontend/src/App.tsx)**

- 所有页面改为 `React.lazy` + 路由级 `Suspense`（fallback 用轻量 Spin/骨架，避免 Ant 全屏 Modal）
- Admin 路由单独 chunk，普通用户永不下载

**改动 [`frontend/src/main.tsx`](frontend/src/main.tsx)**

- `TargetCursor` → `lazy(() => import('./components/TargetCursor'))`，仅在桌面端挂载（组件内已有 mobile 判断，但 **gsap 不应进首包**）

### 2. Vite 分包与可量化基线

**改动 [`frontend/vite.config.ts`](frontend/vite.config.ts)**

```ts
build: {
  rollupOptions: {
    output: {
      manualChunks: {
        vendor: ['react', 'react-dom', 'react-router-dom'],
        antd: ['antd'],
        three: ['three'],

      },
    },
  },
},
```

- 增加 `rollup-plugin-visualizer`（devDependency）或 `vite build --report`，记录 **优化前后** chunk 体积（作为验收指标）

### 3. 运行时渲染隔离（保留动效、减卡顿）

**工作台 [`PolishWorkbenchPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/PolishWorkbenchPage.tsx) + [`ParagraphCompareCard.tsx`](frontend/src/components/ParagraphCompareCard.tsx)**

- 将 `Card/Row/Col` 换成轻量 div + 现有 CSS class（视觉不变，DOM 节点更少）——Impeccable **distill** + 逐字 perf
- 长任务（11+ 段）：非当前段 + 非上一段用 `content-visibility: auto`（已有）；可再加 **仅渲染视口 ±1 段** 的轻量虚拟化（可选 Phase 2，段数 >15 时启用）

**Shader [`animated-shader-background.tsx`](frontend/src/components/ui/animated-shader-background.tsx)**

### 4. CSS 交付优化（不删样式、减少阻塞）

**拆分 [`frontend/src/styles.css`](frontend/src/styles.css)**（逻辑拆分，非删动画）

| 文件 | 内容 | 加载方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `styles/tokens.css` | CSS 变量、主题 | 全局 |
| `styles/base.css` | layout、antd 覆盖 | 全局 |

| `styles/workbench.css` | workbench/stagger/paragraph | lazy：ConsoleLayout 或 Workbench import |
| `styles/admin.css` | admin 专用 | lazy：AdminLayout import |

| 右侧补层 | 全开 | 约 40% |
| 毛玻璃 blur | 开 | 关（半透明实底） |

**原因**：Ant Design 5 滑块的可点击圆点是在 `.ant-slider-handle::after` 伪元素上绘制的，`cursor: pointer` 也写在这个伪元素上。之前只覆盖了 handle 本体，没覆盖 `::before` / `::after`，所以悬停时仍会显示手型。

**改动**：在 `TargetCursor.css` 里为 handle 及其 `::before`、`::after`（含 hover / active / focus）都加了 `cursor: none !important`。

**改动说明**

页面改为**固定桌面布局**，缩小窗口时不再重排、叠乱，只出现横向滚动条（内容可能显示不全）；缩放仍只用浏览器 **Ctrl + / Ctrl -**。

### 1. 最小宽度 1280px
- 在 `tokens.css` 定义 `--app-layout-min-width: 1280px`
- `body` / `#root` / 主应用层设置 `min-width`，`html` 开启 `overflow-x: auto`

### 2. Ant Design 栅格固定为桌面列宽
- 在 `ConfigProvider` 里把所有 `screen*` 断点设为 `0`，`lg` / `xl` 列宽始终生效
- 上传区 16+8、工具区 10+14 等并排布局不再叠成单列

### 3. 去掉窗口宽度触发的 JS 逻辑
- **侧栏**：不再在 ≤991px 时自动收起，只能手动点折叠按钮
- **论文优化页**：去掉窄屏任务列表高度分支，统一用桌面高度公式

### 4. 删除窄屏 CSS
- 移除 `@media (max-width: 991px)` / `576px` 下对顶栏 padding、预览区高度等的覆盖

---

**效果**
- 1920 / 1366 等常见分辨率：首次打开布局一致
- 窗口拖小：布局不变，底部出现横向滚动条
- 需要整体缩小：用浏览器 **Ctrl + -**

**根因找到了**，确实是之前「整体布局优化」叠加 CSS 拆分导致的：

### 问题 1：控制台没加载样式
`console-content-shell`、侧栏 padding、上传卡片布局等都在 **`auth.css`**，但 `ConsoleLayout` 只引入了 `workbench.css`，**论文优化页一直缺这些样式**，间距和排版规则都没生效。

### 问题 2：全局栅格覆盖
为固定布局加的 **全局** `.ant-col-lg-10 / lg-14 / lg-8 …` 会作用到**卡片内部的嵌套 Row**，把工具区和预览区挤乱、叠在一起。

---

### 已修复

1. **`ConsoleLayout` / `AdminLayout` 引入 `auth.css`** — 控制台布局与上传卡样式正常加载  
2. **去掉全局 ant-col 覆盖**，只保留顶栏「上传卡 16 + 参数卡 8」的 scoped 规则  
3. **上传卡内部改为 CSS Grid**（不再用嵌套 `Col`），左 38% 工具 / 右 62% 预览，互不干扰  
4. **加大控件区间距**（`gap: 22px`），参数卡滑条与说明文字也加了间距

## 扣费字数 7,166 怎么来的

系统扣会员额度、扣积分用的是这套规则：

- 每个汉字 = 1
- 每个连续的英文/数字串 = 1（如 `AI`、`AIGC`、`ChatGPT`、`2022`、`3000`、`1` 各算 1 次）

对你的文件实测：

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional, Tuple

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from models.entities import AdWatchTicket, PointState
from repositories import points_repo


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def get_ticket(db: Session, ticket_id: str) -> AdWatchTicket | None:
    return db.get(AdWatchTicket, ticket_id)


def create_ticket(
    db: Session,
    *,
    user_id: str,
    ticket_id: str,
    reward_points: int,
    expires_at: datetime,
) -> Tuple[AdWatchTicket | None, str]:
    ps = points_repo.get_or_create_point_state(db, user_id)
    today = points_repo._today_key()
    ok, reason, _ = points_repo.can_watch_ad(ps, today)
    if not ok:
        db.rollback()
        return None, reason

    row = AdWatchTicket(
        id=ticket_id,
        user_id=user_id,
        status="pending",
        reward_points=reward_points,
        created_at=_now(),
        expires_at=expires_at,
        completed_at=None,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return row, "ok"


def mark_ticket_expired_if_needed(db: Session, row: AdWatchTicket) -> AdWatchTicket:
    if row.status != "pending":
        return row
    if _now() > row.expires_at:
        row.status = "expired"
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(row)
    return row


def complete_ticket_and_credit_points(
    db: Session,
    *,
    ticket_id: str,
) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[int]]:
    """
    幂等完成：仅 pending 且未过期时加分并置 completed。
    返回 (ok, reason, new_writable_words_total)。
    """
    row = db.get(AdWatchTicket, ticket_id)
    if not row:
        return False, "not_found", None
    user_id = row.user_id
    now = _now()
    if row.status == "completed":
        ps = db.get(PointState, user_id)
        total = points_repo.writable_words(ps) if ps else 0
        return True, "already_completed", total
    if now > row.expires_at:
        if row.status == "pending":
            row.status = "expired"
            db.commit()
        return False, "expired", None
    if row.status != "pending":
        return False, row.status, None

    ps = points_repo.get_or_create_point_state(db, user_id)
    today = points_repo._today_key()
    ok, reason, _ = points_repo.can_watch_ad(ps, today)
    if not ok:
        return False, reason, None

    add = int(row.reward_points or 0)
    ps.points = int(ps.points or 0) + add
    points_repo.record_ad_watch(ps, today)
    row.status = "completed"
    row.completed_at = now
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ps)
    return True, "ok", points_repo.writable_words(ps)

已按 **商业化方案 V1.0** 完成实现，主要变更如下：

## 核心规则

| 项目 | 实现 |
|------|------|
| 计费口径 | **1 积分 = 1 汉字**，标点/英文/数字不计 |
| 扣费时机 | **按实际输出汉字数**，在 `/process` 服务端扣费（不再在点「开始」时预扣） |
| 注册奖励 | 新用户 **5000** 字（`auth_repo.create_user`） |
| 每日免费 | 访问 `/api/points/me` 或手动领取：**+1000/天**，池子上限 **3000** |
| 看广告 | **1000 字/次**；普通 **5 次/天**，月会员 **10 次**，高级 **不限** |
| 充值 | 1 元 = 3000 字；套餐 9.9 / 19.9 / **39.9（推荐）** / 99 |
| 会员 | **39 元/月 → 10 万字/月**；**99 元/月 → 50 万字/月**（按月赠送，非字数额度池） |

## 后端

- `backend/pricing.py` — 全部定价常量
- `backend/repositories/points_repo.py` — 每日免费、扣费、会员月赠、广告限额
- `backend/models/entities.py` — `PointState` 扩展字段
- 迁移 `20260602_01_commercial_v1.py`（**已执行**）

- `GET /api/points/me` — 返回 `writableWords`、`dailyFreePoints`、`membershipTier`、广告次数等

## 前端

- 顶栏显示 **「可改写字数」** 而非「积分」
- 概览页：免费体验 / 看广告 / 热门套餐 / 两档会员
- 充值页：5 档套餐 + 推荐标签

已修复，原因有两层：

## 1. TargetCursor 框选在拼音输入时消失
中文 IME 弹出候选窗时会触发输入框的 `mouseleave`，之前会据此取消四角框选。

**修复：**
- 输入框在**聚焦期间**不再因 `mouseleave` 取消框选，只有真正失焦（`focusout`）才取消
- 监听 `compositionupdate` / `input`，拼音组合过程中持续更新框选位置
- 反馈编辑区 `.feedback-rich-editor` 也纳入输入框框选范围

## 2. 受控输入在拼音组合期间被打断
上传区的 `TextArea`、反馈富文本编辑器在 `onChange`/`onInput` 里立刻更新 React 状态，拼音未确认时重渲染会打断 IME。

**修复：**
- 组合输入期间（`compositionstart` → `compositionend`）暂停同步状态，确认后再写入

---

刷新页面后再试：在粘贴文本框或反馈框里打拼音，四角框选应会一直保持到失焦。若还有某个具体输入框复现，告诉我是哪一个页面/字段。

根因是：**第一个拼音键**按下时，浏览器往往在 `compositionstart` 之前就触发 `focusout`，框选被提前取消；第二次聚焦时 `compositionstart` 已能赶上，所以看起来「正常」。

本次改动：

1. **`keydown` 捕获阶段** — 在输入框里按键时立刻锁定并激活框选（早于 IME 的 focusout）
2. **输入交互窗口** — 聚焦/按键后 800ms 内不因失焦取消框选
3. **`focusout` 延迟 180ms 再判断** — 给 `compositionstart` 留出时间，并取消之前的 double-rAF 逻辑
4. **`mouseover` 不抢焦点** — 输入框已聚焦时，鼠标移到下方预览区等元素不会把框选切走
5. **`compositionend` 后短暂续期** — 防止选字刚结束就被误取消

上一版为保拼音框选，在输入框聚焦时阻止了其它元素的 hover 框选。正在收窄锁定条件：仅在 IME 组合或按键后短暂保持，鼠标移到别处应框选对应元素。

**现在的规则：**

| 场景 | 框选行为 |
|------|----------|
| 鼠标移到按钮/链接等 | 框选跟随鼠标目标 |
| 鼠标移出输入框（未打拼音） | 取消输入框框选 |

根因是：**先输入数字再切拼音**时，浏览器常会先触发一次「假 focusout」，而 `compositionstart` 还没到；之前 350ms 的保护窗口也可能已过期，框选就被取消了。

**本次调整：**

1. **假 focusout 检测** — 延迟检查时发现焦点仍在输入框内，则不取消框选（数字后切 IME 很常见）
2. **按键即续期** — 数字/字母/IME 键都会刷新 500–800ms 保护窗，并取消 pending 的 focusout 定时器
3. **不再忽略 `isComposing` 的 keydown** — 组合输入过程中的按键也会续期
4. **`input` + `compositionupdate`** — 组合输入期间持续续期并更新框选位置
5. **布局抖动** — 刚按键后的短窗口内，不让 hover 把框选切到下方预览区

## 新机制：「编辑会话」

在输入框里**任意按键**或**拼音组合**期间，进入编辑会话：

- 框选**强制锁定**在该输入框
- 忽略 IME 造成的假 `focusout`、`mouseleave`
- 鼠标移到别处也不会切走框选
- 每次按键 / `composition` / `beforeinput` 都会**续期**（3–6 秒）

停止输入约 3 秒后，会话结束，框选恢复为正常的 hover 跟随。

## 覆盖的场景

- 第一个拼音键（`keydown` 先于 `compositionstart` 即锁定）
- 先数字再拼音（数字键也会开启会话）
- 候选窗弹出时鼠标离开输入框

请**刷新页面**后再试：点进输入框 → 直接打拼音，或 `123` 后再打拼音，框选应全程保持。

若仍消失，请告诉我：**哪个输入框**、是否先点了别处再回来输入——便于继续查。

content.text:
输入框四角框选逻辑已删掉并重写，核心规则如下。

## 新架构

**`targetCursorInputFrame.ts`** — 独立状态与判断：

- `focusedInput`：当前聚焦的输入框
- `composingEl`：拼音组合中的元素
- `isInputFrameLocked()`：仅在 `compositionstart` → `compositionend` 期间锁定
- `inputStillFocused()`：处理 IME 假 `focusout`

**`TargetCursor.tsx`** — 简化后的行为：

| 事件 | 行为 |
|------|------|
| `focusin` / `keydown` | `pinInputFrame` → 框选固定到输入框 |
| `compositionstart` | 锁定框选，忽略 `mouseleave` |
| `compositionend` | 解锁并刷新框位置 |
| `focusout` | 延迟 160ms 再检查是否仍聚焦，避免 IME 误触 |
| `mousemove` / `mouseover` | IME 锁定时忽略 hover 切换 |
| `scroll` | 输入框仍聚焦时刷新框位置 |

已移除的旧逻辑：`imeEditUntil` 定时器、`beforeinput`、`compositionupdate`、在 `mousemove` 里强制 re-pin 等补丁。

同时补回了窗口 `mouseleave`/`mouseenter` 隐藏光标，以及 `mousedown`/`mouseup` 圆点缩放动画。

## 请验证

1. 点击登录框 / 粘贴区 / 反馈编辑器 → 四角框应出现  
2. 输入拼音（候选窗弹出）→ 框不应消失  
3. 先输入数字再输入拼音 → 框应保持  
4. 鼠标移出输入框 → 框仍跟随输入框（聚焦时）  
5. 点击外部失焦 → 框应消失  

若某一步仍有问题，说明是哪个页面、哪个输入框，我再针对性改。

1. **轮播广告置顶** — `AdCarousel` 移到页面最上方，进入概览第一眼就能看到。

已按「固定桌面布局」策略改好，之后控制台页面都遵循同一规则。

## 策略说明

窗口变窄时：
- **组件大小不变**（每列最小 300px，整页最小 960px）
- **排列不变**（三卡始终横排，会员卡始终左右并排）
- **位置不变**（不因断点改成单列或压缩）
- **显示不全时**在主内容区出现横向滚动条
- 只有用户 **Ctrl + ±** 浏览器缩放才会整体变小

## 具体改动

1. **`tokens.css`** — 新增 `--console-content-min-width: 960px`
2. **`ConsoleLayout` / `AdminLayout`** — 内容区加 `console-fixed-layout` 类
3. **`base.css`**
   - 去掉概览页 `@media (max-width: 991px)` 单列重排
   - Grid 改为 `repeat(3, minmax(300px, 1fr))`，禁止列被压扁
   - 会员卡 Col 强制 50% 宽（忽略 `xs=24` 断点）
   - 滚动限制在 `.console-content-shell` 内，侧栏 fixed 不会被内容盖住
4. **控制台路由** — 取消 body 1280px 强撑，改由内容区 `min-width: 960px` + 内部滚动

缩小窗口后，三卡应仍横排、会员卡仍并排；看不全时在主内容区横向滚动即可。后续新页面放在 `console-fixed-layout` 内，并给并排区块设 `min-width` 即可。

## 修复方案

1. **新增 `useConsoleSiderHeight` hook**  
   监听 `resize` / `visualViewport`，实时计算侧栏高度：  
   `window.innerHeight - 10px(顶) - 10px(底)`，写入 `--console-sider-height-px`。

2. **结构调整**  
   增加 `console-main-scroll-track` 内层：外层只负责横向滚动，侧栏高度不再受 flex/overflow 干扰。

3. **CSS 调整**  
   - 外层：`overflow-y: clip`（避免纵向滚动容器破坏 sticky）  
   - 侧栏高度：优先用 JS 写入的 `--console-sider-height-px`

   - `console-root-layout` → `console-body`（横向滚动）→ `aside` + `main`
2. **侧栏改为原生 `<aside>`**，保留原有样式和折叠逻辑
3. **主内容用 `<main class="console-content-shell">`**，随页面自然增高，不再被裁切
4. **侧栏高度**仍由 `useConsoleSiderHeight` 随窗口更新

已按 **商业化方案 V3.0** 完成前后端对齐，主要变更如下：

## 定价与规则（`pricing.ts` / `backend/pricing.py`）

| 项目 | V3.0 |
|------|------|
| 注册奖励 | **5888 字** |
| 每日签到 | **888 字**（普通会员 2888 / 高级 3888） |
| 看广告 | **2888 字/次**（会员 3888 / 5888） |
| 广告上限 | 普通 **10 次/日**（会员 20 / 30） |
| 首充礼包 | ¥2.99 → **18888 字**（限购一次） |
| 首充会员 | ¥2.99 → **7 天普通会员**（限购一次） |
| 字数包 | 6.99/19.9/39.9/99 四档（38k～128万+字，永久有效） |
| 会员 | 普通 **¥19.9/月** · 高级 **¥39.9/月**（权益为签到/广告加成 + 快速/极速生成） |

后端已支持：**按会员档位发放签到/广告奖励**、**会员过期检查**、**首充 7 天试用**（`trialDays`）。

## 首页布局（`/console/dashboard`）

1. **第一视觉**：「免费获得改写字数」大卡片 + **「立即领取」**（打开看广告二维码）
2. **第二块**：新用户首充 ¥2.99 · 18888 字
3. **第三块**：热门毕业论文包 ¥39.9 · 388888 字
4. **第四块**：会员中心（普通/高级，点击开通）

已移除轮播占首屏；充值/会员不再抢第一视觉。

## 充值页 / 字数页

- 充值页：首充区（2 档）+ 4 个字数包并排
- 字数页：优先「看广告」「每日签到」，充值入口降为次要按钮
- 顶栏与用户文案统一为 **「可改写字数」**，不再对用户展示「积分」

## 使用说明

- 刷新页面即可看到新首页布局
- **重启 backend** 后新规则（5888 注册、2888 广告、10 次/日等）才会在登录账号上生效
- 首充「限购一次」目前用 **本地 localStorage** 记录（演示环境）；正式支付需后续接服务端订单

若还需要把管理后台里的「积分」字段也改成「改写字数」，或把快速/极速生成模式接到实际并行改写逻辑，可以继续说。
